title: Rite of Descension
description: In the land of Liyue by the sea, a city sits atop the solid bedrock. That city is Liyue Harbor, and it has flourished under the protection of its guardian Morax — also known as "Rex Lapis," the Geo Archon you have been looking for. You could not have arrived at a more fortuitous time, as the annual "Rite of Descension" has just begun. Every year on this day, Rex Lapis graces this land with his prophecy, giving guidance on the economic path Liyue should follow in the coming year.

title: Alan Smithee, Author of Fischl
description: You only stopped by the Adventurers' Guild to check for new commissions — it has nothing to do with the witch or her assignment. But it seems you stumble upon an unexpected surprise...

title: A Dry Well Doth Not Reflect the Stars
description: Following the hints in the dictionary, you and Paimon decide to deliver the assignment to Mona. It should be a simple task... or so it seems.

title: Old Friends and New Knowledge
description: Guided by the witch's dictionary, you head to Dragonspine to bring Albedo a brand-new assignment...

title: A Child Wandering the World
description: Inside the witch's dictionary, you discover an unusual message that must be delivered to Durin...

title: Tales of Time and Wind
description: The witch's dictionary doesn't mention any specific task related to Venti, but you still follow its guidance and search for him around Mondstadt...

title: With Lupical...
description: According to the witch's dictionary, this assignment takes place in Wolvendom. Go there and see what awaits you this time...

title: The Law of Boundaries
description: Sucrose is working on a new alchemical potion, but no matter how she tweaks the formula, it never comes out right...

title: Absolute Territorial Domination
description: Absolute Territorial Domination

title: The Great Mage's Journey of Trials
description: The witch's dictionary also includes an assignment that Alice left for Klee. Why not drop by the Knights of Favonius headquarters and ask Klee about it?

title: A Knight's Merit
description: The Knights are busy preparing for an award ceremony in front of the Favonius Cathedral plaza...

title: A Knight's Pursuit
description: What price must one pay in pursuit of power that surpasses mortal ken...?

title: A Knight's Resolve
description: What decision will Lohen make in the face of irrevocable fate? And where will that lead him...?

title: An Impromptu Change of Plan
description: During the rite, the appointed moment arrived. Yet when the clouds parted, a divine carcass crashed down to earth, knocking all the offerings over. Amid the chaos and confusion, the Qixing ordered that the assassin be arrested. Unable to prove your innocence, you were forced to accept the help of Childe of the Fatui, and as suggested by him, you are now headed for Jueyun Karst, a hidden abode where the adepti dwell...

title: Wangshu
description: You came across an adeptus, "Moon Carver." Seeing the keepsake you bore, he lent you his aid and protected you from the Millelith soldiers pursuing you. Upon learning of Rex Lapis' passing and the unjust accusations laid against you, Moon Carver expressed disdain for the Qixing's actions and began to suspect that they were behind what happened. He has sent you to find several other adepti and deliver a message to them.

title: Appearance control logic
description: Appearance control logic

title: Moulder of Mountains
description: Following the instructions of Moon Carver, you arrive at Mt. Hulao in order to meet with Mountain Shaper.

title: Custodian of Clouds
description: Following Moon Carver's instructions, you arrive at Mt. Aocang in order to seek out Cloud Retainer.

title: An Organization Known as Wangsheng
description: Upon your return from visiting the Adepti, you discover that the Qixing have hidden the Geo Archon's vessel away. Childe promised he'd find someone to break the stalemate, so you pay another visit to Northland Bank.

title: Troublesome Work
description: Librarian Lisa seems annoyed about her work...

title: Lost Book
description: Many people forget to return the library books they've borrowed, leaving Lisa no choice but to chase them and retrieve the books. Marjorie and Sara have agreed to return the books they borrowed as soon as possible, but Donna's seems to have been stolen. You decide to track the missing book down by following the trail left by an elemental marking Lisa made on it.

title: Moonfinger
description: Childe introduced you to Zhongli, a consultant at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. You agree to help Zhongli organize the Rite of Parting in the hope of seeing the Geo Archon again.

title: A Child's Secret
description: At the feet of the Anemo Archon Statue in the plaza in front of Mondstadt Cathedral, you and Paimon discover a little girl playing with her imaginary friend...

title: The South Wind Brings Adventure
description: While investigating imaginary friends with Venti, Ellin asked you to search for the adventurer Jack within the Temple of the Lion. It seems he is traveling together with the legendary adventurer, Stanley.

title: Lionfang's Legacy
description: Jack wants to search for Stanley's old weapons in secret, as they are the sword and shield passed down from the Lion of the South, and thus fascinate Jack greatly.

title: Should You Be Trapped in a Windless Land
description: Jack returns home satisfied after a round of adventure. But Venti finds Stanley's behavior odd, and decides to investigate further...

title: Three Poignant Perfumes
description: Zhongli isn't concerned with the deicide itself, but with upholding Liyue's sacred traditions by giving a proper farewell to an archaic lord. Having selected a suitable batch of Noctilucous Jade, your next task is to prepare some perfumes as an offering to the Geo Archon.

title: Shadow of the Past
description: Master Jean has a special task for you. Head to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters to find out more.

title: Speech and Etiquette
description: You successfully locate Eula, who agrees to teach you the customs of the Lawrence Clan. To fulfill the task given to you by Master Jean, it seems you will need to undergo quite the rigorous training program...

title: Through the Motions, to the Heart
description: You get through the aristocratic conduct training, albeit with some hiccups along the way. During the training, you believe you may have discovered what shapes Eula's personality. You say goodbye to Eula and decide to act — first, you will procure a greeting gift, then you will meet with Schubert once more.

title: Downtown
description: Who would have guessed — Madame Ping is an adeptus! After leaving her household, which turned out to be a realm within a teapot, you proceed to Chihu Rock to continue preparations.

title: The Realm Within
description: After identifying Rex Lapis' preferred scent, Zhongli sends you to Yujing Terrace to seek out an old friend of his, Madame Ping, and borrow a certain Cleansing Bell. Strange... Zhongli seems to be avoiding his old friend...

title: Guizhong
description: You came to renowned purveyor of Liyue herbal medicine, Bubu Pharmacy, to procure some Everlasting Incense. But what started out as a straightforward trip to the pharmacy has turned into a far more complicated affair...

title: Zhongli's Treat
description: That Bubu Pharmacy trip turned into quite an exhilarating ride. (Okay, maybe not that exhilarating.) In yet another remarkable twist, Zhongli has offered to treat you to dinner!

title: Dust to Dust
description: Having sought out the adepti and completed the task Moon Carver entrusted to you, you return again to Liyue Harbor to look for Childe. He tells you that the Liyue Qixing's response to the archon's passing has given him some food for thought...

title: The Unexpected Guest
description: Concerned about the situation down in The Chasm, you and Paimon decide to go investigate the area, only to run into someone altogether unexpected there...

title: The Floating Palace
description: The mysterious emissary Ganyu appeared before you at Third-Round Knockout. Claiming to have come at Ningguang's behest, she invited you to the skyfaring palace known as the Jade Chamber. To that end, you and Paimon have come to Mt. Tianheng, from where you can see the Jade Chamber in the distance.

title: Who Is Mondstadt's Strongest Fighter?
description: Customers at the Angel's Share have started debating the hottest topic on Mondstadt's streets: "Who is the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?"

title: The Mystery of the Girl in Red's Treasure
description: You have heard people from various corners weigh in on who the strongest fighter in Mondstadt is, but have yet to get a definite answer. Outside the Knights headquarters, you have an unexpected meeting with one of the candidates for the title — Klee, who is in dire need of help to recover her stolen treasure.

title: A Very Volatile Treasure
description: Klee's highly explosive "treasure" proved to be a remarkably swift solution to the Abyss Mage problem. However, she fled the scene after the explosion. Confused, you decide to return to the Knights headquarters and report the matter to Jean...

title: Equilibrium
description: After arriving at the Guizhong Ballista on Mt. Tianheng, you are surprised to meet another member of the Qixing there. Her name is Keqing, and she gives you detailed instructions on how to ascend to the Jade Chamber. Paimon, however, is preoccupied with another detail that Keqing mentioned: the custom of bringing a greeting gift.

title: Solitary Fragrance
description: You finally ascended to the Jade Chamber, where Ningguang was waiting for you. She graciously accepted Paimon's gift, and offered one in return. You spoke at length about many things: deities, archons... and the Fatui...

title: Heart of Glaze
description: At Ningguang's advice, you verified the Fatui's schemes regarding the Sigil of Permission before continuing to help Zhongli prepare for the rite. You met Ganyu once again at Dihua Marsh before returning to Liyue Harbor — only to find that things in the city seem to be spiraling out of control.

title: Turning Point
description: The adepti faced off against the Qixing outside the city. Just as things were coming to a head, you went to the Golden House to intercept Childe as he attempted to seize the Gnosis, only to find yet another twist: The Gnosis was never at the Golden House to begin with. Childe swiftly switched to his backup plan, attempting to force the Geo Archon to make an appearance by summoning an ancient god with Fatui-forged Sigils of Permission...

title: The Fond Farewell
description: The ancient god was subdued once again following a fierce battle and much sacrifice. The dust settles, and your journey in Liyue is reaching its conclusion with the Rite of Parting. But before that, there are still some mysteries regarding the Geo Archon that need unraveling.

title: Chasmic Maze
description: The ground at the bottom of The Chasm suddenly collapsed, causing everyone to fall in. As it turns out, there is an unknown space further below, and everyone works together to investigate...

title: Danger All Around
description: In order to escape from underground, the party keeps searching for a way out after getting some rest...

title: End of the Line
description: After rendezvousing with Xiao, you and the others go over the curious and unsettling things you have seen underground...

title: （test）芭芭拉线玩法白盒
description: （test）现在是芭芭拉线的玩法白盒，白盒完成后会转为芭芭拉线。

title: At Tunnel's End, Light
description: You and the others make a valiant joint effort and finally manage to escape from the underground at the very last minute...

title: Astrology and the 50-Year Pact
description: You and Paimon went outside Liyue, intending to set off on an adventure...

title: To Mondstadt
description: The astrologist Mona, who you met by chance outside Liyue Harbor, has promised that if you go with her to Mondstadt to fulfill her appointment, she will help you read the truth behind the gods and your sibling. Leaving Liyue Harbor, you head towards Mondstadt.

title: A Bewildering Fate
description: On your journey, you witness Mona's strength as an astrologist, as well as her constraints. At last, you arrive at your destination — Mondstadt.

title: Little Chef on a Hunt
description: On a clear and sunny day, you go for a walk to Springvale with Paimon.

title: Cooking Appointment
description: While out on a stroll, you bumped into a strange girl. This girl, a chef from Liyue by the name of Xiangling, is on a journey to seek out exotic ingredients. She enlists your help in a hunt, but your private hunting expedition appears to have earned the ire of Draff, the leader of the hunters. You head off to apologize to him...

title: Secret Ingredient
description: To your surprise, Draff did not intend to reprimand Xiangling, but instead wanted her to help promote Springvale's meat products instead. Sticking to her principles, Xiangling refused to cook for advertising, and would have left if she was not attracted to the smell of Brook's cooking. What began as a chat devolved into disagreement about how to prepare food, and ended in the declaration of a cook-off between the head chef of Springvale and the chef from Liyue.

title: Lucky Find
description: Xiangling believes that Lotus Heads and Jueyun Chilis alone will not let her prevail in the cook-off, and sets off to find more ingredients.

title: Present From the Past
description: Xiangling took a keen interest in the rumor that the ruins contain a gigantic Cryo Regisvine, and ran inside to investigate. Worried about her safety, you quickly follow the impetuous chef.

title: Cooking Showdown
description: After obtaining the rare ingredients, Xiangling is finally ready for the cook-off. The showdown between the two head chefs is about to begin.

title: (Scrapped)
description: (Scrapped)

title: (Scrapped)
description: (Scrapped)

title: A Teapot to Call Home: Part I
description: The crisis looming over Liyue Harbor has calmed, and it's business as usual in the city. However, Madame Ping, the flower-admirer from Yujing Terrace, seems to have something more to discuss with you...
unlockDescription: Complete this quest to unlock the Serenitea Pot

title: Jade Chamber Rising
description: Liyue Harbor is all abuzz with the news of the Jade Chamber's rebuilding. Go to Yujing Terrace and ask Ningguang for the details.

title: Across the Sea
description: You and Paimon prepare to investigate a ruin near Lingju Pass...

title: Teucer's Terrific Tour
description: The Snezhnayan boy that you met by chance while investigating the Ruin Guards turned out to be Childe's younger brother Teucer. Childe requests that you keep his "identity" a secret and that you give the boy a tour of Liyue.

title: Defender of Childhood Dreams
description: Though the process was winding and awkward, Childe proved able to conceal his identity from his brother. Before Teucer could return to Snezhnaya, Childe agreed to his final request — to tour Liyue's Institute for Toy Research. But in truth, that Institute is...

title: Seagaze Sunset
description: You hear about Sunset Vermillionite from Baizhu and decide to hit up Feiyun Commerce Guild for some information.

title: Bygones Times Like Dust Passing
description: Only two materials left to find. Time to ask around at the worksite.

title: Where the Heart Finds Rest
description: The time when the Jade Chamber takes to the skies again is drawing closer. Who knows what will happen when it finally does?

title: Seven-Star Selection
description: As you stroll around Liyue, you bump into a familiar person...

title: Candidature Analysis
description: Yelan does not seem particularly reassured by Zhiyi and decides to go down to the wharf to speak to Bolai and find out how well he is rated by others.

title: Shadow of Yore
description: You and Paimon recognize a familiar face as you come aboard the Pearl Galley...

title: Vortex's Wake
description: After your chance meeting with Zhongli, you learn that a Fatuus named Kliment is trying to organize an archaeological expedition. Zhongli is roped in as a consultant, along with an archaeologist named Wanyan who volunteers for the task. Though you distrust the Fatui, you join up at Zhongli's invitation. The first subject of this investigation is Osial, Overlord of the Vortex.

title: A Ruin Under Lock and Key
description: The expedition to investigate Osial in the Guyun Stone Forest came away with slim pickings. Kliment and Wanyan also clashed vociferously over their differing perspectives, which has greatly displeased the former. During the argument, he heard Wanyan mention the tale of the God of Salt, and decided to take the party there to try their luck, lest he finishes this venture empty-handed.

title: Farewell, Sweet Salt
description: With the aid of Zhongli's knowledge, you are able to undo the seals, but before entering the ruin, he lays a condition before Wanyan and Kliment: to alternate who gets claim to each treasure encountered, with only one object permitted per claim.

title: A Record of All Things
description: Within the ruins, Kliment and Wanyan each betray the contract in turn for personal reasons. As punishment, Kliment is cast out of the ruin and deprived of his reward. Wanyan is made to witness a truth that shatters her beliefs — the God of Salt was gentle but weak and was betrayed and slain as a result. Bearing witness to this incident and filled with conflicted feelings as a result, you follow Zhongli back to Guyun Stone Forest.

title: Foregone Conclusion
description: You decide to announce the Zhiyi has passed the selection to make him lower his guard. Now all that's left to do is wait...

title: The Search for a Physician
description: Someone seems to be asking for help outside Bubu Pharmacy...

title: The Quest for a Cure
description: There seems to be something else going on with the poison in Jialiang's body...

title: The Formula for a Miracle
description: The boundary between medicine and poison seems to have blurred, as has the line between life and death... Where can one find a truly perfect remedy, or does it exist at all?

title: The Illuminated Beast of the Sea of Clouds
description: The three secretaries who originally worked at the Jade Chamber have appeared at Yujing Terrace. It looks like something has them tearing their hair out...

title: A Secretary in a Sea of Humanity
description: Caught between the world of humans and adepti, Ganyu has descended into a funk. After she hits a snag in her plan to return to Jueyun Karst, you follow Ganyu back to Liyue Harbor, intending to resolve her misunderstanding that she has been dismissed from her post...

title: A Pact That Crosses Time
description: Accepting the commission of the Tianshu, Uncle Tian, Ganyu very naturally slips into her work mode, coming to the aid of her junior colleague Huixin with ease in the latter's time of need. To express her thanks, Huixin invites you all to Xinyue Kiosk to have a meal...

title: Leisurely Chatter
description: Paimon has a sudden yearning for the quirky stories told by Cloud Retainer. Go to Mt. Aocang to see this adeptus, with whom you are quite familiar.

title: A Search for Secrets
description: While eating at Wanmin Restaurant, you encounter Yuandai and Shuyu. Yuandai, forgetful in her old age, cannot remember her past, but perhaps her having once been a chivalrous heroine is a good place to start...

title: Lovely Dreams
description: Unexpectedly, the final clue leads back to Mt. Aocang. Did Yuandai once live there? Why didn't Cloud Retainer mention this? Either way, time to head back there and see if Yuandai recalls anything.

title: The Rumored Alchemist
description: You arrive at Timaeus' alchemy store in Mondstadt one day to stock up on adventuring supplies. But here, you encounter someone altogether unexpected...

title: The Genius Researcher and the Seed of Another World
description: While searching for Albedo, you encounter an odd-looking sister named Rosaria. She claims to know where Albedo is and expresses her willingness to show you the way.

title: The First Experiment: Elements
description: After finding Albedo, Rosaria leaves on her own. You chat with Albedo and discover the objective of his research: to use alchemy to cause a seed from another world to sprout and flourish. To better understand otherworldly lifeforms, Albedo states his desire to observe you and to perform some experiments in the process.

title: The Third Experiment: Life
description: After the elemental flow tests, Albedo asks you to display any special, otherworldly abilities you may have, though nothing comes of this. Still, Albedo's interest in you has not waned in the least...

title: The Second Experiment: The World
description: After the experiment begins, Albedo first checks your elemental flow. The result is that both your internal and external elemental flows run smoothly and that there is nothing unusual about them. These results seem very normal indeed, but according to Albedo, this is something to be happy about.

title: The Final Experiment: Withering Glory
description: As the experiments proceed, Albedo obtains more and more data related to you, and the alchemy he envisages begins to take shape. Finally, after a simple test of your physical capabilities, the experiments draw to a close...

title: The Master of Stars' Deception
description: You discover some hilichurls near Wangshu Inn that are giving off dark energy, just as an adeptus who calls himself Starsnatcher is performing some exorcist arts nearby...

title: Glimmers of the Vigilant Yaksha
description: As payment to attain Starsnatcher's help, you prepare to go to Wanwen Bookhouse to purchase books about cooking. Upon arriving at the bookstore, you find...

title: The Purging of Evil
description: Starsnatcher's ability to purge evil stems from the Sigil of Permission. After an unforeseen mishap, you give chase to a group of hilichurls with an evil aura...

title: Insights of Drifting Dreams
description: Under Xiao's guidance, you prepare to use adepti arts to recover the Sigil of Permission and warn the false adeptus of his evil ways. You will confront the false adeptus in a dream and teach him a lesson...

title: The Mysterious Wangsheng Parlor
description: Your adventure takes you to Wuwang Hill, where Paimon senses that something is amiss...

title: In Pursuit of a Phantom
description: When you agreed to help Hu Tao and followed her to the Adventurers' Guild, you hadn't counted on becoming part of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor's "business development" efforts. No topic is too sensitive for Hu Tao — certainly not matters of life and death — and even though some of her points make sense, you find them somewhat difficult to stomach. Then, when you voice your doubts about her approach, she tells you that she has long since moved on from business development to her next objective: finding someone called "Big G."

title: Friendships, Wishes, and Regrets
description: Meng tells you that Big G is his childhood friend, who died by misadventure. Filled with regret and worry, Meng believes that due to a supernatural turn of events, Big G has become an evil spirit. Luocheng, another superstitious person who believes in ghost stories just like Meng, visits the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor seeking an exorcism. However, Hu Tao knows that the source of their worries is imaginary, so she comes up with an equally make-believe solution and organizes a fake exorcism. Surprisingly, the spirit of Big G appears before your eyes after the ritual.

title: Perfect Send-Off
description: It turns out that Big G's spirit was attracted by the exorcism. Upon learning that Big G has not become a malevolent spirit and simply wanted to check on Meng and other childhood friends, Hu Tao decides to fulfill his wish and organize a farewell ceremony for him. To give him peace of mind, you collect keepsakes and well-wishes that Big G's childhood friends prepared for him. The only thing left now is to send him off.

title: Strange Sights, Stolen Souls
description: Katheryne of the Adventurers' Guild in Liyue Harbor has a new commission for you. You and Paimon decide to find out what it's all about.

title: Truth in the Stones
description: You arrive at the mine, the scene of the incident, and begin your investigation. A series of clues makes clear that there is nothing ordinary about this disappearance. What is the connection between the mysterious person behind this incident and the missing miners? Where did the missing miners disappear to? You have to know the truth.

title: Shifting Earth and Lost Threads Come to Light
description: The evidence at the mining site suggests that the miners followed the road north. You follow the trail, gradually closing in on them.

title: Amidst Chaos, the Rock Is Unmoved
description: Finally, you reach Nantianmen. A curious ancient tree has quietly stood here throughout the ages, bearing witness to all that has come to pass. To rescue the miners and solve this puzzle once and for all, you proceed to the ancient site that holds all the answers...

title: Justice, for Books' Sake
description: Paimon wants to know whether the Wanwen Bookhouse has the Liyue volume of the Teyvat Travel Guide in stock.

title: Know Thyself, Know Thy Enemy
description: Your book search sent you to Qingce Village to look for Chang the Ninth. But you arrived to find thugs are trying to force Chang into a bad business deal. Xingqiu won't stand for this, and wants to find out more about the business magnate behind it — Gentry Maocai.

title: Calm Before the Storm
description: It turns out Gentry Maocai needs a great deal of Cor Lapis to satisfy an order from the Fatui. Xingqiu has written a letter to the Feiyun Commerce Guild, hoping that they can help.

title: Justice Is Its Own Reward
description: As per Xingqiu's plan, the Feiyun Commerce Guild bought up all the Cor Lapis in Liyue Harbor. All that remains is to purchase Chang the Ninth's batch and Gentry Maocai will have nowhere left to turn.

title: A Private Commission
description: Kamisato Ayaka seems to have something to discuss with you. Meet up for a chat with her at Komore Teahouse.

title: Woven Wishes
description: At Ayaka's request, you and Paimon accompany her to prepare gifts necessary to meet "Tsubaki."

title: Food From Afar
description: While the clothes are being made, Ayaka suggests that you and Paimon come with her to Kiminami Restaurant to dine.

title: Lasting Promise
description: Having prepared the gifts, you travel together to the place where "Tsubaki" lives.

title: With You
description: Now knowing that all this came from her mother's childhood wish, Kamisato Ayaka invites you to go with her to Amakane Island to take part in a festivity that she has been looking forward to for a long time now.

title: The Oni's Evil
description: Inazuma's Katheryne would like you to help conduct an emergency investigation...

title: The Firework Girl's Strange Stories
description: You've been in Inazuma for a while now, but your investigations continue. One day, you and Paimon arrive at the seaside...

title: Expectations Not to Be Betrayed
description: You return with Yoimiya to Naganohara Fireworks, but discover a stowaway hiding inside the shop named Sakujirou. To prevent his capture at the hands of the Tenryou Commission, you must find a way for him to leave Inazuma while preparing for a fireworks show.

title: A Sliver of Hope
description: Though you and Yoimiya managed to secure Sakujirou's passage out by sea, he wavers, unable to reconcile himself to his wish. It is at this moment that Yoimiya recalls an old couple among Naganohara Fireworks' clients who might be able to help him out.

title: Together Under the Fireworks
description: Unexpectedly, this old couple's child is the Tenryou Commission's Imatani Keisuke, an old acquaintance of Sakujirou's. However, the two of them once had a sharp disagreement, and so Yoimiya is unable to use this prior relationship to help Sakujirou out of his bind. As the Tenryou Commission closes in on Naganohara Fireworks, Yoimiya fears that Sakujirou will forever forfeit his chance to fulfill his wish...

title: The Lonesome Euthymia
description: Your adventure has come to an end for now. You and Paimon decide to pay the Statue of the Omnipresent God a visit...

title: To Traverse the Mortal Plane
description: The Shogun seems to be indisposed for some reason, but you, quite unexpectedly, manage to invite Ei to come forth from her Plane of Euthymia. You decide to take her on a trip around town for a change of pace.

title: The Fabric of Constancy
description: With you as her tour guide, Ei witnesses a great many new things and even seems to be enjoying herself. You decide to remember this leisurely time by taking a picture.

title: To Hear Mortal Hearts
description: Ippei says that Kujou Kamaji has gone to see the head of the Takatsukasa Clan. Ei decides to go there personally to settle the issue of the Tenryou Commission's internal affairs. Thus, you and Ei head out into the wilds, toward the secret base of the Takatsukasa Clan...

title: Watatsumi Sightseeing
description: The war is over, and you have received a letter from Kokomi, saying that Watatsumi Island is going to hold a Victory Feast, and that she would like you to attend. However, when you arrive on Watatsumi Island, you find that not all is right with the world here...

title: Rumors Abound
description: Peace talks between Watatsumi Island and the Tenryou Commission are due to commence, but a rumor that the Tenryou Commission remains in cahoots with the Fatui is still circulating around the island. To uncover the truth, Kokomi decides to assault the Fatui's temporary encampment...

title: Her Secret
description: You have agreed to meet Kokomi near Sangonomiya Shrine. Time to move out.

title: Victory Banquet
description: Go to the site of the Victory Feast with Kokomi and listen to her speech.

title: New Beginning
description: You hurry towards the site where the peace talks are to begin. What will the future of Watatsumi Island and the Shogunate look like?

title: The Oni's Justice
description: You set off to Yashiori Island using the clues Sango provided...

title: The Oni's Pride
description: After Daisuke points out the inconsistencies in his story, Arataki Itto is forced to reveal to you that he is currently acting to protect the blue oni. To ascertain the truth, you agree to set out with Itto once again.

title: Mysterious Urban Legend
description: You planned to visit the Yae Publishing House, but after arriving in Hanamizaka, you find that it is more lively than usual here...

title: Friendship in Writing
description: It turns out that Youhei and Shingo had summoned a spirit with the method recorded in "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits." Yae Miko suggests going to the Yae Publishing House to discuss how to respond...

title: A Centuries-Long Dream
description: The light novel is a great hit. It has successfully outshone "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits." Now, it is time to catch the spirit behind it.

title: Banquet of Parting
description: What can we do for these youkai? If you were to answer honestly, it could only be a grand farewell party.

title: New Shoots from Old Branches
description: As you and Paimon pass by Ogura Textiles & Kimonos, you bump into two rather familiar people...

title: The Truth Is Also a Lie
description: As you go off to send your well-wishes, Ayato gradually realizes that there is some plot at play behind this wedding. According to his reasoning, you are rapidly approaching the truth...

title: The Wind Settles
description: Ayato claims that your job is done and that all that remains is to wait for the Kanjou Commission's internal reaction. Will things really proceed as he thinks they will?

title: Upon the Plain, a Purple Shadow
description: You and Paimon travel near Byakko Plain on your journey...

title: Through the Mist, a Name Unveiled
description: To prevent the attacker from causing more harm, you and Kazuha decide to investigate his identity.

title: Ere the End, a Glance Back
description: As it turns out, the one behind the missing person case is a cursed blade that has possessed Amenoma Yuuya's body. To save the latter and to prove the absurdity of the blade's fixation, Kazuha eventually takes up the cursed blade himself.

title: Cleansing Light
description: The Adventurers' Guild in Inazuma seems to have a commission concerning the Sacred Sakura...

title: Farewell to the Past
description: Many people's memories have escaped from the damaged roots of the Sacred Sakura. Raiden Ei takes the opportunity to tell you many stories about her cherished friends and the Inazuma she wants to protect.

title: Radiant Sakura
description: In Raiden Makoto's remnant realm of consciousness, Ei and the Shogun Puppet engage in an endless fight. For Inazuma, and also for Ei herself, you wish to lend a hand — as you once did — to help her get through this sore test.

title: Encounter in the Realm of Dreams
description: Following Paimon's whim, you return to Inazuma where you encounter an unknown youkai. Intrigued by this small creature, you are drawn into a moonlit encounter...

title: Crisis at the Aisa Bathhouse
description: You and Paimon follow the address on Mizuki's invitation and find your way to the Aisa Bathhouse. However, before you take the chance to enjoy a pleasant soak, it strikes you that business at the bathhouse isn't going so well...

title: A Deceit Called Happiness
description: The financial troubles at the Aisa Bathhouse appear to be almost over when a sudden turn of events turns everything on its head. You and Mizuki soon realize that the root cause of the crisis still persists...

title: Descendant of Nightmares
description: On a lonely and desolate island, you and Mizuki discover the hiding place of Emura Chuuya. It seems that the truth behind the recent nightmares may well be lurking inside...

title: Afterword
description: The nightmare crisis has finally been resolved and you have received a new invitation letter from Mizuki. Finally time for Paimon to enjoy the all-inclusive spa day she's been so looking forward to...

title: The Start of Contamination
description: You haven't gone to see Katheryne in a while. Why don't you go have a look?

title: Into the Hinterland
description: With the mechanical crab as your guide, it is time to head to the contaminated region.

title: Heart of the Machine
description: The mechanical crab has stopped at a certain point. The source of the contamination seems to be within.

title: Garden Memories
description: Now that you've left the lab, you should inform Katheryne that the contamination issue has been resolved.

title: The Warm Rhythm of the Streets
description: To prepare supplies for your adventure, you and Paimon come to the Grand Bazaar...

title: Show Canceled
description: With your encouragement, Nilou decided to debate with the Akademiya scholar about the demolition of the theatre. Thus, she needs to collect a lot of information.

title: The Reason We Are Gathered Here
description: Everything is ready and now it's up to Nilou's performance in the debate.

title: Suspicious Smuggling Case
description: You decide to take a look around the Akademiya...

title: Chain of Interests
description: You repelled the chasing mercenaries and now it is time to leave for the desert.

title: All Returns to Silence
description: It seems that even a matra is involved in the Canned Knowledge smuggling. Cyno decided to let you take the secret letter back to the Akademiya and enter the Restricted Repository to procure information.

title: Dream of Awakening
description: One day, you and Paimon notice that many people in Sumeru City are talking about dreams...

title: Dream of Falling
description: You realize that many people may be experiencing unusual dreams just like Ilman. To prevent the dreams from causing more harm, you must return to "A Moment of Dreams" to take measures.

title: Dream of Farewell
description: The artificial dream failed to erase suffering but instead created a sweet illusion. It has gone out of control and eventually collapsed. Everyone has now returned to reality with mixed feelings...

title: Where Lies the Path Home
description: One day, you and Paimon run into an old friend at Sumeru's city gates...

title: Fragmented Testimony
description: You've heard that Alhaitham has become the Acting Grand Sage. Considering his personality, will the other scholars accept him? Time to pay the Akademiya a visit.

title: A Thorough Investigation
description: Ilyas remembered two things that he had to do, one of which is to collect his pay at the Research Preparation Center.

title: Pride and Prejudice
description: While stopping by Gandharva Ville, Ilyas managed to recover his memories. It's now time to follow him to Siraj's hideout.

title: Shade Upon Red Silk
description: One day, you and Paimon stop by the Grand Bazaar...

title: Annals of the Scarlet Sands
description: During your investigation, you accidentally stumbled upon Dunyarzad's father's name. After discussing the matter with Dehya, she decides that Dunyarzad should be informed of all that has transpired...

title: Sincerity's Facade
description: The truth is revealed. Dehya's father has long passed. Still, his comrades in arms seek to avenge him. Before judgment falls, Dehya decides to lend them her aid.

title: What Shape Does the Self Hold
description: From your investigation, it seems that Apep might be terminally ill. To learn how to save it, you must make a trip to The Chasm and find a special elemental life-form.

title: Another Home There May Yet Be
description: The elemental life-forms' "family" linger around for a long time. In order for them to be reunited one day, you have to first properly deal with the parting in the present moment...

title: The Seeker of a Meteor Shower
description: Back in Inazuma, Yoimiya is preparing for a romantic journey...

title: All Things Flawless and Pure
description: You and Paimon tell Yoimiya that meteor showers respond to people's wishes. In response, Yoimiya wants to spend some time getting herself ready for the occasion...

title: A Flower that Blooms Across the Sky
description: Avin doesn't want to forget her Aranara friend, so you resolve to help her recover the wonderful memories of her past. The Aranara you summoned is also happy to lend a hand...

title: The Mysterious Letter
description: You and Paimon return to Sumeru to visit some local friends.

title: After Repose
description: It's been some time since your last meeting. You and Paimon are invited to go camping with Cyno, Tighnari, and Collei.

title: Footprints Sunken Beneath the Sands
description: Cyrus's strange situation puts everyone on alert, and Cyno went after him alone. As his friends, you, Paimon, and Tighnari could never turn a blind eye to his predicament.

title: Sage of Sages
description: Sethos leads you into the ancient Temple of Silence. There, you learn why Cyrus went into the desert alone, and the origin of Cyno's power. Next, it's time to face the requirements of the Temple of Silence.

title: The Dead Past is the Living Present
description: After the sands have settled, you and the others bid farewell to the ancient grounds and return to the Akademiya...

title: The Phantom Thief's Reappearance
description: The bustling streets of the Court of Fontaine seem more lively than usual. Why not take a walk around?

title: The Magician's Secret
description: Lyney and you agreed to meet outside Hotel Debord. Go meet him at the appointed time.

title: The Truest Thing
description: With the Phantom Weasel arrested, Lyney's show can finally take place. Fingers crossed that everything goes smoothly...

title: The Interview
description: What's made headlines today? Go to The Steambird and check it out!

title: An Opportunity for Rebirth
description: You and Paimon arrive at the dormitories in the Fortress of Meropide...

title: The Proud "Beret Society"
description: Through your conversation, you learn of an organization known as the "Beret Society" that provides support for prisoners who feel helpless and lonely. Wriothesley suggests that you come with him and take a look at their daily lives.

title: It's What He Deserves
description: Evidence from Avice suggests that the Beret Society's leader, Dougier, has been using extremely cruel methods to control its members. No one could sit there and watch such evil deeds unfold.

title: A Familiar Threat
description: Paimon is curious about Neuvillette. Go talk to him.

title: Ever-Surging Memories
description: Neuvillette comes up with another way to investigate — using his powers to search for memories and emotions within the Fountain of Lucine. You hope everything goes as planned...

title: In a New Light
description: You learn of the culprit's name from the criminals Navia gathered. However, that person is currently at the Fortress of Meropide. It looks like you'll have to make a trip down there...

title: To Yesterday
description: One day, you and Paimon arrive at the Adventurers' Guild to check out the commissions there...

title: Whither Should the Water Flow?
description: Having met with the troupe, you learn two critical members have yet to return. First is Pauleau, who is responsible for completing the script. He is in Poisson.

title: This Life, Just Like a Light Trickle of Song
description: The members of the troupe do not see eye to eye on the ending of the script, and everyone believes they should hear what the last member, Vilmant, has to say on it. So, you set off from Poisson...

title: Shimmering Memories
description: One day, you are stopped by a familiar voice while in the Court of Fontaine...

title: Lost and Inherited
description: Colter tells you stories of the Spina di Rosula's past. After a rest, it is time to head off to the Court of Fontaine.

title: Yesterday's Tears, Tomorrow's Light
description: You have a pleasant time and a fine night in the Fleuve Cendre. It is time to go and give the clothes you picked up to Adele.

title: Where Honed Blades Clash
description: A fashion festival is being held in Fontaine. You and Paimon decide to check it out for yourselves...

title: Stained Spots
description: If the hem of a skirt is stained, can it still take the stage?

title: The Woven and the Cut
description: What should one forsake, and where should one persist? The answer that the designer gives amidst cutting and knitting is...

title: The Child Who Doesn't Exist
description: It's a fine day. Yes, a fine day for a stroll around Poisson!

title: Sea Breeze Rendezvous
description: After discussing the plan with Lyney and the others, you go to the seaside to meet The Knave in an attempt to distract her...

title: Birds in a Cage
description: After hearing some "secrets" of the House of the Hearth from Clervie, the conflicts between the children have begun to surface...

title: Into the Sunlight
description: The Knave is well aware of the plans Lyney and the others have hatched. She proposes a deal that seems to be a good chance to get to the bottom of all this...

title: Beauty Expert
description: The Court of Fontaine seems to be holding quite a lively promotion event.

title: Switcheroo
description: After Sigewinne finally finishes a busy day as head nurse, it seems as though a new problem has already arrived...

title: Underground Crime
description: A new clue discovered in Rawat's mother's residence seems to be a critical piece of evidence allowing the investigation to proceed.

title: The Truth of What Was
description: The many-layered mysterious case caused by cosmetics has now been fully solved, and after Sigewinne finishes helping the Marechaussee Phantom wind up the case, she prepares to tell you a story about the past...

title: "Judgment Day"
description: On the streets of the Court of Fontaine, a pair of familiar faces seem to need your help...

title: Hunters' Gathering
description: "A long, long time ago..."

title: Buried Honor
description: There seems to be something unusual about today's story...

title: Vanquishing Phantoms
description: "Now, as we face the perils of the long night..."

title: Top Note: Floral Debt
description: Port Ormos has been exceptionally lively lately. It looks like preparations for something big are underway...

title: Middle Note: Blood Due
description: The disputes behind "Auguste" seem to be far more complex than you expected...

title: Base Note: Auguste
description: The true identity of "Kirya" has finally been exposed... His path of vengeance reaching its end.

title: Shaped by Fame
description: Navia seems to be keeping an eye on something in front of Hotel Debord...

title: Roasted by Flames
description: As Escoffier promised, a fiery culinary showdown is about to begin...

title: Ice-Frosted Endgame
description: Behind the turmoil, a cold truth awaits...

title: A Mysterious Visitor From Huitztlan
description: You encounter two kids beneath the cliffs outside the Scions of the Canopy tribe. They seem to require some help...

title: A Hero's Rite
description: Having arrived at the Scions of the Canopy, you meet the young girl you helped before, Huni...

title: Kinich's Deal
description: An unexpected encounter finds you just as you are planning to go to Elder Trinidad's dwelling...

title: I, Flame Bearer
description: Following your deal with Kinich, you prepare to walk around the tribe, making room for him to maneuver...

title: The Last Turnfire Night
description: Having finished your preparations, the last Turnfire Night approaches...

title: Those Searching for the Mysterious Island
description: While wandering in the wilderness, you hear two tourists crying for help, and you and Paimon decide to aid them...

title: The Legend of the Mysterious Island
description: Your curiosity having been piqued, you decide to head to the People of the Springs, and ask the tribal leader about the legends of the mysterious island.

title: Someone Trustworthy
description: It turns out that in order to reach the mysterious island, it is necessary to have a guide, one with whom mutual trust is shared...

title: Where the Koholasaurs Gather
description: The predeparture preparations are complete. It's time to go to the location you and Mualani agreed on...

title: The Riddle of Sea and Sky
description: Mualani successfully figures out the next destination based on the clues found in the valley, but it seems that new challenges await you there...

title: The Mysterious Island's Truth
description: You finally determine the mysterious island's location, but whether or not you'll be able to finish your journey as you desire remains to be seen...

title: Tepetli Dissonance
description: Within the Children of Echoes, Imix, from Muhuru's Gemporium, seems to have run into some major difficulties...

title: Threadlike Whispers
description: The time you and Tlazolli agreed upon has almost arrived. You prepare to pay her a visit to check on the Blazegem Inscription's progress.

title: A Faint Signal Lingers
description: Xilonen has caught a glimpse of the Blazegem Inscriptions' forging process and has guessed what Tlazolli means to use them for. For safety reasons, she will dismantle this particular Inscription and analyze its inner workings first, and then decide whether to help Tlazolli save the gravely ill Nechca.

title: Wailing Cacophony
description: Tlazolli has revealed her true intentions, coercing "Nechca" into her self-proclaimed "abandoned" workshop. If you wish to save the child who sought your help, you must pursue them.

title: Serenity's Reprise
description: Tlazolli awaits her punishment, Nepecha has regained her "name," and the Blazegem Inscriptions are about to be destroyed. The nightmare and entrapment have both dissipated, and it is all over. Xilonen has also brought Nepecha to her own workshop. Perhaps she still has something in mind...

title: Hoarse Echoes
description: You visit Cheven at the agreed-upon time. At her invitation, you decide to see the former master artisan Tlazolli.

title: Ardent Land of Plenty
description: As you arrive at the outskirts of the Great Volcano of Tollan, you come across a young girl by the roadside...

title: The Wingless One of Tlalocan
description: There seems to be a crestfallen person near the Flower-Feather Clan...

title: The Night Before the Trial
description: After resolving the Wingless's problem, you rush back to the trial site...

title: Tracks Through the Wilderness
description: The Flower-Feather Clan's flying trials have officially started, but a shocking sight greets those at the site...

title: Mortal Pursuit
description: Coya attacked humans to rescue her daughter. The clues point toward a craftsperson named Tepal...

title: Time for the Showdown
description: In the distant skies, far from the surface, the airborne workshop bears silent witness to the amassing and annihilation of obsession...

title: Calling from the Masters of the Night-Wind
description: After happening across a baby Iktomisaurus, a mysterious presence guides you into the Masters of the Night-Wind's settlement...

title: Legendary "Color"
description: You accept the Chief of the Masters of the Night-Wind's commission, and are determined to complete the task that you have been entrusted with...

title: A Commission Catches You in Natlan
description: You and Paimon bump into a squad of Fatui at the Masters of the Night-Wind, and you meet their employer. Thus does a commission from Fontaine find its way to you...

title: Please, great shaman!
description: After you sincerely beseech her, Citlali finally agrees to help. But to your surprise, Granny Itztli's name does not merely bring with it assistance...

title: Seven-Hued Ruins
description: With Citlali's assistance, you find the ruins left behind by the Battle of Seven Colors. However, the truth that awaits your discovery is far beyond your expectations...

title: The Color of Memory
description: After all has been settled, Citlali invites you to her dwelling. It seems she's found an answer to the question that was troubling her before...

title: Sage Supreme
description: The fateful day of the Epic Feast Showdown has arrived, and you hunger for the taste of challenge.

title: The Meaning of Courage
description: With hearts as one, you and Varesa set out to investigate the true identity and intentions of the Sage-Lord of Fungi.

title: Smokeless War
description: You've finally found some key materials. All that's left is to cook the mushroom and see what happens...

title: Orchard Repose
description: Varesa accompanies you to her home, the Collective of Plenty, to introduce you to the local customs.

title: Sinister Undercurrent
description: On an otherwise ordinary day on the road, you suddenly feel a strange discomfort...

title: Special Training
description: Skirk agrees to help investigate the mysterious person's whereabouts. In the meantime, you should work on improving your strength.

title: All Devouring
description: Your training is over and Skirk has located the culprit behind the scenes. Proceed with caution.

title: Heart and Mind
description: Skirk's strength is returning quickly but she still doesn't seem to be satisfied. She thinks something's wrong with her body and hopes to solve her problems through meditation. You arrange to see her in a couple of days. Hopefully, everything works out as planned...

title: Unbounded
description: After reconciling with herself, Skirk awakens once more and reclaims her full powers. It's time to teach the culprit a lesson.

title: To a Carefree Vacation!
description: As summer blooms once more, you and Paimon arrive in Tenochtzitoc and prepare yourselves for a carefree vacation...

title: To Colorfall Cliffs!
description: Bennett told you about a scenic spot called "Foamflower Fields" at Colorfall Cliffs...

title: To Guiztli Ridge!
description: Chasca told you about some head-to-head challenges at Guiztli Ridge...

title: To Wavey Bay!
description: Mualani told you about the many aquatic attractions on offer at Wavey Bay...

title: The World Is Your Canvas!
description: The warm sunlight shines on your back, urging you to set off once again. Well, what are you waiting for? Stretch your legs and enjoy the Easybreeze Holiday Resort with all your friends!

title: The Surprise That Awaits Us All!
description: The Easybreeze Album is filled with the happy memories of your time spent with everyone. At last, the time has come for prizes to be presented...

title: A Curtain Call for a Colorful Summer Night!
description: Until the sun rises once more...

title: Time to Test the Twilight Cruise!
description: The flagship attraction, "Twilight Cruise," is waiting for professional testers...

title: Time to Test the Asha Speedrun!
description: The flagship attraction, "Asha Speedrun," is waiting for professional testers...

title: A Mother's Last Wish
description: While traveling, you receive a sudden invitation from Alice. She hopes you and Paimon can help Durin fulfill a wish — one connected to his late mother, "M"...

title: A Prophecy From the Past
description: The story in the book seems to describe Durin's experiences. Curious about what remains untold, you and Durin step back into its pages to uncover the missing parts of his story.

title: Fate's Accursed Wiles
description: The book reveals that Durin is bound by a curse born of prophecy. You recall how a blessing once helped him overcome it in Simulanka — maybe reliving that moment will complete the story...

title: Revelation Beneath the Stars
description: Why do people start to forget Durin? You and Paimon have no clue. Just then, the magic book offers another hint — M's story does not end in Simulanka. And the next chapter seems to lead to where Durin first set foot in this world...

title: The Solution of Fate
description: Following the clues from the previous chapter, you head to Dragonspine to find Albedo. It seems the mysteries around Durin are about to be revealed, but the trials prepared by "fate" are waiting for you as well...

title: Interlude: A Moment's Rest
description: The book gives no new hints for now. You decide to rest for a while before meeting Durin again...

title: Interlude: A Moment's Rest
description: The book gives no new hints for now. You decide to rest for a while before meeting Durin again...

title: Interlude: A Moment's Rest
description: Durin's unexpected accident disrupts your original plans, and you have no choice but to wait for him to wake up...

title: Interlude: A Moment's Rest
description: You find an important clue, but until Albedo returns, the full truth remains out of reach...

title: Triumphant Warrior
description: Through everyone's united efforts, the Abyssal calamity in the north seems to have been quelled...\nThe day of triumph draws near.

title: Fated Warrior
description: The scryglass reflects visions of the future, the wolf spirit harbors memories of the past...\nThe threads of fate are ever-changing.

title: Lonely Warrior
description: Even if you had an army of ten thousand men, in the end, you must face this fight alone...\nStep forward... lonely warrior.

title: The Championship Begins
description: Following a tranquil stay in Nod-Krai, you check in with Katheryne to see if anything noteworthy has happened lately.

title: Twice Upon a Gaze
description: Having completed the qualifiers successfully, Linnea suggests going to Speranza to celebrate properly...

title: Tread the Right Path
description: After waking from her dream, Linnea decides to seek Celaeno out once more and uncover the whole truth.

title: Bough Keeper: Dainsleif
description: Katheryne of the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild seems to have something to tell you.

title: Sister Victoria's Vexation
description: Sister Victoria seems to be troubled by something...

title: Sudden Shouting
description: Someone suddenly starts calling for Barbara in Wolvendom...

title: The Church's Affairs
description: At Barbara's request, you head back to Mondstadt to report to Sister Victoria.

title: The First Chilibrew Ingredient
description: To make some Chilibrew, Barbara has asked you to look for some fresh Jueyun Chilis near the Stone Gate.

title: Knight and Deaconess, Ready for Battle!
description: Repel the Treasure Hoarders and rescue the merchant being threatened by them.

title: The Second Chilibrew Ingredient
description: To make some Chilibrew, you prepare to go with Barbara to the Whispering Woods to look for some Sweet Flowers.

title: Ulterior Motive...?
description: Defeat the suspicious person

title: Healing Is My Job
description: To heal Uwe, you accompany Barbara to search the Whispering Woods for Small Lamp Grass.

title: A Very Special Beverage
description: After helping to clean up the Cathedral, you get ready to meet Barbara at The Cat's Tail.

title: Give It Up!
description: Sayu has been discovered by Kano Nana, and has no choice but to return to Chinju Forest to practice ninjutsu. She begs you to come along, and so you do...

title: A Mysterious Order
description: As you walk through Inazuma City, you feel a strange gaze from somewhere around you.

title: Bottleneck Breaking
description: You tell Sayu that she needs enough nutrition to grow tall. She follows you enthusiastically to Inazuma City...

title: Sleep Alone Can't Wait
description: Rather than working or training, Sayu thinks that sleeping is of the utmost urgency and importance.

title: Operation Substitution
description: So Sayu wanted you to learn ninjutsu so that you could replace her at work...

title: Shuumatsuban Suspicions
description: You decide to investigate the Shuumatsuban personally. You and Sayu decide to lure the person who gave the order out...

title: Countryside Wandering
description: Yunning of the Yun-Han Opera Troupe is currently outside Liyue branch of the Adventurers' Guild, fretting over someone's disappearance.

title: Accidental Encounter
description: You meet Gorou and Yae Miko near Yae Publishing House. Gorou seems to be somewhat troubled...

title: What Shall We Do?
description: You decide to help Gorou find a way to defeat Yae Miko so that he may exorcise his fears.

title: Special Training
description: To help Gorou exorcise his fears, you play the roles of people he is not good at dealing with. However...

title: Hard to Track
description: As you approach the wharf of Liyue Harbor, an unusually-dressed young man comes up to you, asking after some really strange business...

title: Distant Gaze
description: The young thaumaturge Chongyun has obtained a great amount of (rather unreliable-sounding) information concerning evil spirits. He seems a little dejected when you point this out. As he uses a popsicle to suppress his pure-yang spirit, you both feel someone's gaze on you from the side.

title: The Exorcist's Path
description: Dalong leaves after having been given half the popsicles, feeling quite pleased. After this small interlude, you and Chongyun continue discussing evil spirits. Chongyun hopes to tap on your abundant experience as an adventurer to adjudge the truth or falsehood of information concerning evil spirits. To that end, you head to Wanwen Bookhouse together.

title: Popsicles and Their Curious Uses
description: Dalong leaves after having been given all the popsicles, feeling most pleased. For Chongyun, these popsicles are essential to suppressing his pure-yang spirit, and so he must have some on his person at any given time. The two of you head to Wanmin Restaurant to restock.

title: For A Child's Smile
description: Chongyun's mind is still on that kid named Dalong even after you've made some more popsicles. The two of you head to Chihu Rock, intending to give the new popsicles to him as well.

title: Secret Identity
description: You were here at Yae Publishing House to keep watch, but...

title: A Friend's Path
description: While writing replies, Gorou encounters a letter from one of his subordinates and is once again troubled...

title: Ordinary Memorial
description: Gorou says that his box is at the Adventurers' Guild. Go with him to ask Katheryne.

title: Test of Courage
description: The young thaumaturge Chongyun has obtained a great amount of (rather unreliable-sounding) information concerning evil spirits, but you decide not to expose this fact out of courtesy. The way Chongyun sees it, the most likely spot for evil spirits to show up is Wuwang Hill, where a Test of Courage is currently taking place. The test requires two people to go in together, so you accept his invitation and accompany him there...

title: Sudden Discomfort
description: You and Chongyun successfully enter the Test of Courage, but as you track the evil spirits, Chongyun suddenly experiences a rush of unstable yang energy and must rest. To prevent his constitution from going out of control, you look for something that might help suppress his pure-yang spirit...

title: Independent Actions
description: Chongyun's pure-yang spirit has finally been brought under control, but he is now aware that the strange goings-on during the Test of Courage are a result of human activity. However, neither of you is ready to give up yet, and at Chongyun's suggestion, you split up and continue to search for traces of the paranormal...

title: Ever Deeper
description: You and Chongyun successfully enter the Test of Courage, and despite causing a misunderstanding, you also gain knowledge of evil spirits. The two of you proceed deeper, equal parts expectant and cautious.

title: The Bottom of Things
description: You and Chongyun successfully enter the Test of Courage, but as you track the evil spirits, Chongyun suddenly experiences a rush of unstable yang energy and must rest. But it would be a shame to leave without having found any evil spirits. And so you forge on alone, leaving Chongyun behind to rest.

title: Killjoy
description: After a conversation with the Test of Courage staff, you discover that the spooky things happening there are all instigated by humans. While you expected as much, you imagine that Chongyun would be quite disappointed if you told him so...

title: The Missing Person
description: Bantan Sango Detective Agency issued a curious commission. You wonder what case it is that even detectives have gotten out of their depths.

title: After the Curtain Falls
description: Yun Jin wandered into a perilous place while searching for inspiration, and would have been in trouble if not for your intervention. To thank you, she agrees to meet you after her performance...

title: Backstage Suspicions
description: The self-proclaimed Editor-in-Chief of The Steambird and a journalist come for an ad-hoc interview with Yun Jin, but they seem somewhat suspicious...

title: The Missing Thing
description: It turns out that the missing young detective was investigating a mysterious case on Watatsumi Island. According to him, something vital is missing on this island. What could it be?

title: Half a Day's Leisure
description: Yun Jin declines a great number of invitations to spend a laid-back day with you at Chihu Rock...

title: Adventurous Acquaintance
description: You make the acquaintance of a rather passionate adventurer at the front desk of the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild...

title: Something... Other Than Adventure?
description: You agree to travel with Bennett, but you're doing some things unrelated to adventure this time — for example... running around the city?

title: What Is This, a Day Trip?
description: You agree to travel with Bennett, but you're doing some things unrelated to adventure this time — for example... having a stroll in the great outdoors?

title: Treacherous Thermadon
description: You should only go adventuring after making sure that you're fully prepared! You and Bennett prepare some food before you challenge the Deserted Ruins of Thermadon.

title: Expansive Eya
description: An adventurer requires naught but courage and strength. The two of you prepare to head directly to the Deserted Ruins of Eya.

title: First Glimpse of Meaning
description: Yun Jin wandered into a perilous place while searching for inspiration, and would have been in trouble if not for your intervention. To thank you, she agrees to teach you some acting techniques...

title: A Special Guest
description: The Crux returns safely from Inazuma and is preparing to celebrate. The only difference is that today, you're the guest of honor...

title: Life on the High Seas
description: At Beidou's invitation, you take part in the "Shield of the Crux" sailor training. Time to get a taste of life out at sea, far from any dry land...

title: Beneath the Surface
description: At Beidou's invitation, you take part in the "Spear of the Crux" sailor training. Time to get a taste of the side of sailor life that few know about...

title: Guili Plains Treasure Hunt
description: At your suggestion, the two of you decide to seek the treasure in the Guili Plains. What will you encounter on the way?

title: Qingce Village Treasure Hunt
description: At your suggestion, the two of you decide to seek the treasure in Qingce Village. What will you encounter on the way?

title: The Missing Thing
