title: The Continuation of the Sabzeruz Festival
description: You come to attend today's Sabzeruz Festival, but you are haunted by a lingering sense of déjà vu...

title: The Samsara of the Sabzeruz Festival
description: Now you know very well that this is not the first time you have attended the Sabzeruz Festival. To save Dunyarzad, you must find a way to get to the bottom of the truth.

title: The Causality of the Sabzeruz Festival
description: The samsara of the Sabzeruz Festival continues. Are you really getting close to the truth?

title: The End of the Sabzeruz Festival
description: Discovering the truth behind the samsara of the Sabzeruz Festival is not enough. You still need to find a way to break out of it. The good news is, you now see a glimmer of hope...

title: Dawn
description: In the end, Nilou's dance ushered in the dawn. If memory serves, you seemed to have seen Dunyarzad in front of the stage...

title: The Empty Illusions of the Sabzeruz Festival
description: In your memory, you never seem to have tried to go outside the city, which is curious.\nToday you decide to try...

title: Like a Triumphant Hero
description: It has been a long time since the Sabzeruz samsara, and many things cannot be ascertained until Nahida gets back in form. Today, you go to the Adventurers' Guild as usual...

title: The Gaze From a Certain God
description: The unexpected appearance of the Fatui Harbinger, The Doctor, means that the Fatui must have played a part in the nefarious plot involving the Sumeru Akademiya... You must act now.

title: The Four at Loggerheads
description: You have temporarily lost Nahida's help, but according to the message she left behind, you will meet someone in the desert who can help you get out of the woods. To foil the nefarious plot between the Akademiya and the Fatui, you set off on another journey.

title: The Missing Village Keepers
description: Entrusted by Isak, a resident of Aaru Village, you and Cyno begin looking for clues about the Village Keepers...

title: Cry From the Eleazar Hospital
description: After arresting the Radicals together with Dehya, you escorted them back to Aaru Village. The testimony revealed the involvement of a mysterious man and his forces. At the same time, Alhaitham has appeared in front of the village chief's house...

title: Secret of the Scorching Desert
description: As agreed, you go to the place designated by Rahman to exchange hostages...

title: Jnagarbha Day
description: The Akademiya's Jnagarbha Day has finally come. All your plans and preparations are for one purpose, and one purpose only — to save a god.

title: Through the Predawn Night
description: As agreed, you and the others gather in the village chief's house to hold a meeting...

title: As by a God's Side
description: As your plan progresses, more and more preparations have been done for the important day. However, this does not mean the process is as smooth as can be...

title: A Toast to Victory
description: The operation to save Lesser Lord Kusanali has concluded. Despite the many surreal experiences that ensued, you feel surprisingly calm after waking up again in bed, facing the rising sun.

title: Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies
description: Although you have saved Lesser Lord Kusanali, there is no time to celebrate or rest, for there is a nascent god to stop and Irminsul to save... Now, the fate of Teyvat is in your hands.

title: The Night-Bird Falls at the Curtain's Call
description: In order to look for more information about your sibling, you and Paimon decide to visit Nahida in the Sanctuary of Surasthana once more. Along the way, you hear people discussing something...

title: A Dance of Destruction
description: The Balladeer has caused a series of unexpected consequences within Irminsul, and you're the only one aware of that. In order to ascertain the situation, you head off to Inazuma...

title: The Kabukimono's Finale
description: The information you gathered left you with a heavy heart. You decide to return to the Sanctuary of Surasthana and tell Nahida about everything you learned...

title: As Though Morning Dew
description: The puppet has given up his original name. Just as the title "Wanderer" suggests, he has truly become a person with no name.

title: Where Flowers Awaken
description: Following a tranquil stay in Nod-Krai, you check in with Katheryne to see if anything noteworthy has happened lately.

title: A Divergence Leading to Oneself
description: The situation appears far worse than you previously imagined, with anomalies occurring in Irminsul and Nahida in a coma... It seems best to first leave Sumeru City with everyone and head for Caravan Ribat.

title: Ancient Shadows Re-Emerge
description: The Jinn-induced sandstorm has subsided. Return to the Temple of Silence and discuss the situation with your friends.

title: Winds of the Past
description: To stop Stormterror's siege, you must venture out and eliminate the elemental flows left within the ruined Temples of the Four Winds. Amber is waiting for you at the Temple of the Falcon.

title: Crash Course
description: Kaeya will accompany you to explore the Temple of the Wolf.

title: Sparks Amongst the Pages
description: Lisa is in charge of clearing the Temple of the Lion alongside you.

title: First Stage Ended
description: After completing the first stage, talk to Paimon for a hidden quest

title: Wanderer's Trail
description: The god took away your only kin, and you were sealed and cast into a deep slumber. Upon your awakening, you wandered alone for a time until you met a strange companion named Paimon, thus beginning your journey through the continent of Teyvat...

title: Bird's Eye View
description: You begin your journey in Starfell Valley, exploring the land and seeing its sights together with Paimon.

title: Unexpected Power
description: As you advanced, a Statue of The Seven appeared on the horizon ahead of you. At Paimon's suggestion, you go to investigate.

title: Wind-Riding Knight
description: On the path to Mondstadt, you inadvertently eavesdropped on a meeting between a huge dragon and a mysterious figure. As you proceeded with various doubts in mind, a perky young girl showed up to block your path.

title: Forest Rendezvous
description: Unexpectedly, the power of Anemo within the Statue of The Seven resonated with you. You decided to begin your investigation with the Anemo Archon of Teyvat's Seven Archons. As such, the first order of the day is to reach the land under the Anemo Archon's protection: Mondstadt.

title: City of Freedom
description: With your help, the problem was resolved quickly. Led by Amber, you reach the city of freedom — Mondstadt.

title: Dragon Storm
description: The usually peaceful Mondstadt was suddenly assailed by a dragon. This is the Stormterror that Amber spoke of, and was the gigantic creature that you encountered in the forest earlier.

title: Knights of Favonius
description: You repelled Stormterror with some difficulty. Kaeya of the Knights of Favonius witnessed the battle, and you were invited to make a trip to the Knights headquarters.

title: Going Upon the Breeze
description: The girl's name is Amber, and her duty as an Outrider is to escort you to Mondstadt. However, she has another task to attend to first, which is to clean out the hilichurls that have been wandering around outside the city.

title: Shadow Over Mondstadt
description: Thanks to your efforts, Mondstadt's elemental flow has returned to normal. It's time to report back to Jean.

title: Unexpected Encounter
description: Returning to Mondstadt, you encountered a clash between Jean and the Fatui. Afterward, you showed Jean the dragon tear that you found in the forest, and at her request, once again joined the investigation into Stormterror Dvalin.

title: That Green Fellow
description: As you were heading out to investigate, you happened upon the mysterious guy that you saw talking to the dragon.

title: Let the Wind Lead
description: The mysterious fellow claimed to be a bard named Venti, but left on his own accord before you could get him to explain his relationship with the dragon. You follow him to the giant tree at Windrise.

title: Venti's Plan
description: Stopped at last, Venti explained that he had tried and failed to cleanse Dvalin's curse during their previous meeting. Now, he has been forced to rely on the Holy Lyre der Himmel's power if he is to restore Dvalin.

title: Venti's New Plan
description: Venti's plan to sweet talk his way into getting the Holy Lyre back backfires. He's come up with a new plan, but seems he'll need your help for it to work.

title: Wild Escape
description: Venti's plan to steal the Holy Lyre went off without a hitch. Well, almost — when the Lyre was almost in your hands, a stranger stole it from under your noses. Your movements alerted the guards, forcing you to flee the Cathedral.

title: Behind the Scenes
description: In your haste fleeing from the confusion, you found yourself in Diluc's tavern, where — to your surprise — he decided to help hide you. Diluc agrees to meet back at the tavern after nightfall with his "contacts" — who could they be?

title: State of the Holy Lyre der Himmel
description: After a fierce battle, you managed to seize the Holy Lyre der Himmel back from the hands of the Fatui. For some reason, Venti seems to express a great nostalgia for the Lyre...

title: Fallen Tears
description: The Holy Lyre is in poor condition, but you manage to restore some of its Anemo power by using Dvalin's tears. To restore its full power, you will need to look for more tears.

title: Hidden Tears
description: Dvalin's footprints are all over Mondstadt, and one of his tears fell upon a ruin deep within the forest.

title: Stolen Tears
description: The corrupted dragon tear has even attracted hilichurls. You must get it back from them.

title: Crystal Tears
description: After completing the retrieval of the tears, you meet up with the rest of the group.

title: Reunion With the Dragon
description: Dvalin's tears restored the Holy Lyre back to its full power. Now, you are finally ready to purify Stormterror.

title: Let's go on an Adventure
description: The Adventurers' Guild can give you Adventure Reports on the area surrounding Mondstadt. All reports are free!

title: Hurdle
description: You came to Stormterror's Lair to once again attempt Dvalin's rescue. However, it is surrounded by wind barriers made by Stormterror, and the dark forces at work have no intention of letting you break through those barriers so easily.

title: Empty Abode
description: Assailed by many enemies, you realize that this road will not be an easy one. The way into Stormterror's Lair is strewn with obstacles, and so you must proceed with caution to find a path along the ruined walls.

title: Light Guiding Ceremony
description: The entrance to Stormterror's Lair is just ahead, but the light seals bar the way in. You must once again face a trial in order to break those seals.

title: Calm Before the Storm
description: The three light seals have each been broken by you in their turn, and the path to the decisive showdown is open. You once again return to the lair's entrance to put an end to things.

title: A Long Shot
description: After a long and daring pursuit of Dvalin, who has been led astray by the Abyss Mages, you are about to finally confront him once and for all.

title: Ending Note
description: Amber says that Jean is waiting for you at the Cathedral. Apparently, it's something to do with the Holy Lyre der Himmel...

title: Abyss Mage
description: You used the Holy Lyre der Himmel to summon Stormterror, only to be prevented from saving it due to the interference of the Abyss Order. But you haven't given up yet — and Diluc has been able to swiftly obtain a new lead...

title: When the Wind Dies Down
description: You finally managed to save Dvalin. Is this where the story of the wind ends?

title: Like the Faint Moonlight of Yesteryear
description: Lyney has been acquitted, but you are not sure about what your next step should be. You decide to take up Navia's offer for a farewell meal to celebrate your cooperation...

title: Liyue: Theater Mechanicus
description: Ruijin from Liyue Harbor is promoting a new "game"...

title: Towards the Lanterns Origin
description: Every year, on the day of the first full moon, the Lantern Rite of Liyue takes place. On that night, everyone in Liyue releases Xiao Lanterns and Mingxiao Lanterns into the bright night sky. Within each of the xiao lanterns, placed a natural levitation stone, and on it hung one's wishful prayer, or a painting depicting one's desire. The lanterns slowly fly away while carrying a hope that the lights emitted by the lanterns might guide the soul of once Liyue's faithful protector, to return and reunite once more. You and Paimon have arrived at this solemn moment of Liyue, preparing for your five-days-long journey...

title: Water Beneath the Lanterns Flows Deep
description: The most awaited moment of the Lantern Rite is the time when a giant Mingxiao Lantern released into the sky on the night of the fifth day. And the size of the Mingxiao Lantern this year is a sight that you don't want to miss, as the levitation stone used to make the giant lantern float this year is the biggest in 20 years. On this special occasion, the merchants of Liyue have prepared a Xiao Market, which was built using the same materials as the lanterns. When you arrived at the Xiao Market, the event organizer Huixin asked you for a favor...

title: In the City of Geo Live the Adepti
description: Materials which are used to make lanterns are all easily flammable, and they're piling up at Liyue's port. Between the mountains of materials, you saw a mysterious figure, which shortly got annoyed by your presence and told you off. You and Paimon shared a look and stared at the piles of wood, paper, and oil... You have a bad feeling about this and you went to the Ministry of Civil Affairs to report the situation. Now you're wondering how they're handling the situation, and you've decided to go and see.

title: To My Old Friend, Wind Brings My Greetings
description: After receiving your help, Millelith is finally able to assign a little group to reinforce their defenses around the city. Unsatisfied with the lack of effort from them, you've come back to the area hoping to find more clues. To your surprise, you met Xiao, a Liyue adeptus who also has the same intention as you. You both discovered that there are some markings at the corners of the construction site. "If a shackle within the realm of deities and demons got loose, I shall take full responsibility." "But this time, the threat comes from the mortal world —— your world, and thus, you shall take full responsibility, mortal traveler." said the adeptus to you. To decipher the markings and to learn its origin, you're reminded of that person that you've met in Mondstadt, a knight who prioritizes results above all else without caring about every trivial law...

title: Lanterns in the Sea
description: Through Kaeya's informant, you found out that it's a kind of communication marking used by the Treasure Thieves, a criminal organization spanning across Teyvat. It seems this whole thing is not as serious as you originally thought. The Treasure Thieves in Liyue just received an anonymous letter. Out of fear and respect for Xiao, the Treasure Thieves gave the letter to you. The sender requested that someone of high rank from the Treasure Thieves meet with them secretly in Liyue to discuss an important matter. Once again, out of fear and respect for Xiao, they agreed to let you play as a high ranking official of the Treasure Thieves and meet the mysterious sender.

title: （test）海灯节氛围npc控制
description: （test）氛围npc控制（隐藏）

title: （test）海灯节可疑小贼npc控制
description: （test）小贼npc控制（隐藏）

title: Lantern Rite Rewards
description: Lantern Rite Rewards

title: The Truth, Lost With the Rain
description: You're now involved in the "serial disappearances of young women" case, whether you like it or not. From the new intelligence you gained from your encounter at the Fountain of Lucine, you and Navia prepare for the next step in your investigation...

title: Mysterious Islands: Journey to the Unknown
description: Long time no Klee — let's go visit her at the Knights of Favonius headquarters!

title: Summer Vacation: Proceed With Caution
description: Though these islands seem completely cut off from the rest of the world, they are somehow chock-full of hidden secrets and mysterious mechanisms. The party settles here for now and starts to get a taste of island life in the summer...

title: Dodo-King of the Sea: Lying in Wait
description: The party learns from Barbara that their surroundings seem to be changing once again. Where will the trail lead this time? How many stories lay buried among these islands? And who know what the next surprise will be?

title: The Final Riddle: A Secret Uncovered
description: Thanks to a joint effort, the party finds the key to solving the final riddle. The truth behind these islands is now within reach, but Klee seems to be more anxious than ever. What is the truth that has quietly sat in wait all this time?

title: One for the Foodies, Two for the Show
description: Paimon, ever-gluttonous, pulls you over to Wanmin Restaurant for a good meal. There, you happen to meet Xiangling, who is deep in thought...

title: Three to Get Ready, and Here We Go
description: With the finals looming, you and Paimon go to Wanmin Restaurant to look for Xiangling...

title: Archipelago Quest 1
description: The billowing waves of summer competition are just around the corner. Full speed ahead, mateys! Failure is not an option!

title: When All Return to the Waters
description: Your investigations did not bear much fruit, but a new suspect has been hauled up for trial at the opera house. You and Navia must split up and do your best to uncover the truth...

title: A Tricky Situation
description: The situation in Inazuma has stabilized, but neither you nor Paimon has been idle. You decide to head over to the Adventurers' Guild and accept a new commission...

title: Pushing On
description: After some waiting, the Mystic Onmyou Chamber has finished rearranging itself. You prepare to meet up with Xinyan and enter the Chamber once more to help Shiki Taishou regain its memories...

title: Away With Obsessions and Falsehood
description: The time for the critical battle has arrived. You return to the Mystic Onmyou Chamber and meet up with Childe and Shiki Taishou. Time to get to the bottom of all these mysteries...

title: Path of the Taishou
description: This storm has passed. You and Paimon prepare to visit Shiki Taishou again to see how the Mystic Onmyou Chamber is doing...

title: The Snowy Past
description: Paimon has an odd thought and drags you off to the Mondstadt alchemy shop...

title: The Snowy Past
description: Paimon, struck by a bout of imagination, drags you off to the alchemy store in Mondstadt to expound her bold hypothesis to Sucrose and Timaeus, but is told that the best person to answer such questions is, in fact, the scholarly Albedo. However, the person waiting for you there is...

title: The Shadows Deepen
description: Having been invited to serve as instructors at the Adventurers' Guild winter camp, you reach an agreement with Albedo, who is also conducting research in the mountains, to find out what happened here. The path towards the truth is winding and long, and you keep encountering new things...

title: The Shadows Deepen
description: Having been invited to serve as instructors at the Adventurers' Guild winter camp, you reach an agreement with Albedo, who is also conducting research in the mountains, to find out what happened here. The path towards the truth is winding and long, and you keep encountering new things...

title: A Secret Born From Ashes
description: You return to Dragonspine with your tale to meet Albedo at the encampment. The hitherto unknown secret may yet lie buried on this mysterious and perilous snowy mountain...

title: Bantan Sango Case File: Mystery of the Black Shadow
description: Someone needs to help take up a mysterious case that has come up in Inazuma...

title: Bantan Sango Case File: Stealthy Trail
description: Ryuuji seems to have gotten some new leads and needs to investigate further...

title: Bantan Sango Case File: The Truth (Just About) Comes to Light
description: Ryuuji seems to have gotten further leads and must investigate once more...

title: Bantan Sango Case File: Recognition
description: The case draws to a close. The truth is at hand...

title: The Blazing Stars Ring in Fortune
description: Lantern Rite has come around again. You and Paimon go and ask the people of Liyue about this year's festival preparations.

title: Sky-Gazers, Land-Walkers
description: At Keqing's request, you accompany her to look into the matter of festive gift-giving...

title: The Stars Inscribe the Year's Wishes
description: The unexpected fireworks theft has caused Keqing to be even busier.

title: Petal-Lit Ships Fish For the Moon
description: Ningguang seems to be thinking about something...

title: Soloist's Prologue
description: It is time to go to Fontaine, it seems. The next phase of your journey is about to begin...

title: The Bright-Windowed Lanterns Hide Their Shadows
description: Yuan Rong of Liyue Harbor has created something fascinating known as the Shadow Lantern...

title: Lost in the Snow
description: Joel asks you to ahead into the mountain to look for his father, who has yet to return from an adventure of his own...

title: Three Realms Gateway Offering: The Eve
description: Learning that the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri was successfully conducted, you prepare to go pay Kokomi a visit...

title: Three Realms Gateway Offering: Part I
description: You must activate three Light Realm Chisels at the Three Border Corners of Enkanomiya to cleanse the darkness.

title: Three Realms Gateway Offering: Part II
description: Tsumi recommends a step-by-step approach to taking on the three towers. Time to take a short break...

title: The City of Rains and Remembrance
description: After a brisk meeting with the Hydro Archon, you decide to, at Lyney's invitation, attend his and Lynette's premiere magic performance at the opera house.

title: Three Realms Gateway Offering: Part III
description: Tsumi recommends a step-by-step approach to taking on the three towers. Time to take a short break...

title: Three Realms Gateway Offering: Aftermath
description: Although you solved the issue of the towers of the three realms in the three corners, and the darkness covering Enkanomiya has been cleared, a specter of unease still hangs over the Dainichi Mikoshi...

title: A Strange Story in Konda
description: A mysterious, masked shrine maiden is by the strange fox statue, seemingly with something to request of you...

title: The Strange Tale of Suikou's Tipsy Tincture
What the Blue Flowers Left Behind
A New Painting in Pale Scarlet
Lies Cast Shadows Under Gathered Lights
description: A sudden accident occurs at the scene of the magic show, and the chosen audience member is also nowhere to be found. All indications point to Lyney and Lynette, but you have your doubts...

title: That Which Our Ancestors Entrusted
description: Concerned about the progress of the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri, you decide to visit Sangonomiya Shrine...

title: The Golden Apple Vacation Returns!
description: As summer comes into its own, you receive a mysterious letter. "To Whomsoever Finds This Letter" — the sender seems to be waiting for someone...

title: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared
description: The first day on the island was rather peaceful, yet things start to get strange the next morning... and this seems to only be the beginning. You and the others trace the strange phenomena to an island and find a bonsai that is not supposed to be there.

title: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared
description: After touching the bonsai, everyone enters some kind of mysterious mirage — an old mansion where the long-forgotten past of a clan resurfaces... This place is intimately linked to Kaedehara Kazuha.

title: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared
description: As you explore further, the mirage becomes ever more peculiar. Perhaps the decrepit view is a reflection of what Kazuha has been through. You wonder how those hardships he experienced will shape the view in his heart.

title: Blazin' Trails
description: Following the result of Mona's divination, the party heads to another island. There, you see a strangely shaped plant which looks like... some kind of musical instrument?

title: Blazin' Trails
description: After drinking the spring water you found for her and recovering her voice, the fiery flower named "Blazing Heart" sends you and the others to the hall of music. The city in the mirage is strikingly similar to Liyue Harbor...

title: Into the Deepwater Murk
description: The open day has finally arrived. This is undoubtedly a good chance to find some information. You and Paimon plan to act, and search for clues in the Fortress of Meropide...

title: Blazin' Trails
description: Plants and instruments, melodies and memories, old acquaintances and her hometown... All of them constitute a crucial part of Xinyan's music. There must be some reason that her mirage has shown up on this special island.

title: Immernachtreich Apokalypse
description: Fischl has not returned, so the party decides to explore the island first and confirm whether there is a mirage as the divination result indicated and to whom it belongs. Soon, everyone finds a night raven statue, along with a mysterious book that it has brought here — Hymn of the Holy Land. After touching the book, you and the others enter the mirage within...

title: Immernachtreich Apokalypse
description: A lofty castle, an unforgettable tale... This must be Fischl's imaginary world. Her mirage is so amazing that every visitor is deeply impressed. However, a mesmerizing dream does not come without a price, just as beautiful flowers often bloom among thistles and thorns...

title: Immernachtreich Apokalypse
description: There is another Fischl here — born from the darkness, she dominates everything in Immernachtreich. Can fear and cowardice devour souls? Which one of the two Prinzessinnen shall triumph in the end?

title: The Ancient Azure Stars
description: Without the need for further divination, everyone heads to the final island in search of the next mirage.

title: The Ancient Azure Stars
description: Upon hearing the voices deep within her heart, Mona becomes lost in some old memories. She has a unique understanding of Astrology and believes in fate regardless of what others think. With this belief in her heart, she leads everyone to explore the mirage...

title: The Ancient Azure Stars
description: The vast expanse of the starry sky extends endlessly into the distance, with many a fate hidden within. It is simply fascinating: The beautiful sky stands silently in the mirage, its bosom wide and vast, its very existence ancient and gentle, as if it was born to embrace all hankerings after destiny and to grace everyone with its compassion. Mona understands fate in a way similar to this starry sky.

title: Like Rhyme and Song, the Summer Reverie
description: To find out the truth, everyone returns to the location of the mysterious machine to investigate.

title: Sounds From Afar
description: As the harvest season arrives, the Mondstadt's Adventurers' Guild has received a great number of requests from the citizenry. You and Paimon have also arrived back in the city in response to Katheryne's call for aid...

title: Bonds of Melody
description: Razor decides to make some Thousand-Wind Wine personally to better understand his human parents. However, which ingredients, specifically, was Venti's song referring to?

title: The Truth Shrouded in Shadow
description: The appointed day has come. You and Paimon go to the Production Zone once more. Lyney will be waiting for you there.

title: Aroma of the Past
description: The Knights have provided Razor with the ingredients he needs, and preparations seem to almost be complete. Head over to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters to check in on them.

title: The Most Fantastic Tournament You've Never Heard Of?
description: The people of Sumeru are gradually returning to their peaceful daily lives, but you and Paimon notice a strange sign while on your way to find new commissions...

title: Nilotpala Cup: Debut Match
description: The Nilotpala Cup qualifiers have started. Time to fight alongside Bongo-Head against other beast tamers!

title: Dual Missions: Progress and Probe!
description: After learning about Haniyyah's prejudice against Fungi, you seem to have one more reason to win: You won't let her do anything reckless!

title: Unfathomable Defenses
description: The Nilotpala Cup continues. With many clues collected, new opportunities seem to have emerged.

title: The Strongest Opponent! The Biggest Crisis!
description: It is the day of the grand finale. Can you change Haniyyah's mind and find a proper way to help the Fungi settle down? Everything hinges on your success!

title: Farewell, My Shroom Buddies
description: It's about time to say goodbye to your shroom buddies...

title: Test of Courage
description: You heard that the Test of Courage is being held. Maybe you should head to the Yashiro Commission to have a look...

title: Secret Keepers and Forbidden Zones
description: The Duke, Wriothesley, holds all the Fortress's secrets. You plan to ask him directly and get some grasp of the current situation.

title: Haunted Tales
description: You encountered something peculiar in the first round, and the second is just about to begin...

title: The Currents of Life
description: You thought it was all a misunderstanding caused by youkai, not expecting there to be a secret behind it all...

title: A Thousand Miles for an Enigmatic Tune
description: You return to Liyue with Paimon in anticipation of yet another unforgettable time at the Lantern Rite Festival...

title: A Single Harmony for an Irreplaceable Soul
description: You and Ganyu had agreed to look separately for clues about the woman in Dvorak's story. Now, it's time to meet up...

title: Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament
description: A fabulous tournament is well underway at Port Ormos

title: Between Facades and Familiar Faces
description: It's now time to attend Hu Tao's dinner. You head to Xinyue Kiosk with Paimon in tow...

title: A Gathering of Outlanders
description: As the Windblume Festival approaches, you and Paimon return to Mondstadt, grasped in the throes of festivity, and take on a rather different commission than you are used to...

title: A Riddle Amidst the Crowds
description: Even though the clues are few and vague, you and Sucrose continue to work at uncovering the mystery behind the prophecy...

title: Joy Above the Clouds
description: Your friends have promised to provide clues and new ideas to solve the riddle. You expectantly wait at the agreed upon time, planning to convene and go over all you have learned with Sucrose...

title: Calamitous Tread
description: Just as everything seems to have returned to normal, an unknown catastrophe arrives suddenly, like a thief in the night...

title: Opening Festivities
description: Paimon heard from someone or somewhere news about the Akademiya Extravaganza. Head to the Akademiya and ask around for details.

title: Competition on the Sands
description: The Interdarshan Championship has entered the second round. This round takes place in the desert. Head to the Aaru Village sub-venue to see how things are going...

title: Suspicions Aroused
description: The second round has come to an end, but there are some matters that haven't been resolved...

title: To Claim the Crown
description: Time passes by. You're not sure if Aarav has completed his investigation behind the kidnapping case and uncovered the truth yet...

title: The Arc of Intellect
description: With the breaking of the diadem, all has come to an end. Head to the main venue and join Kaveh's award ceremony.

title: Commence! A Suspect Genesis
description: The King of Invokations Grand Prix is underway! Unbeknownst to all, however, there is an even more startling event hiding in its shadow...

title: Roll! A Sea of New Acquaintances
description: With the cast of the dice, a series of duels arise in Liyue. Yet, the enigma behind the scenes grows ever more peculiar...

title: Cards Out! Grievances Begone
description: These duels are once in a century! Each table is a storm of activity, and old grudges will be settled on this day!

title: A Tea Party Most Thorny
description: Now that the serial disappearances case has been solved, you decide to rest up for a while, but something is stirring in the dark...

title: Culminate! Chatter of Joyous Dreams
description: The truth is revealed! What an unpredictable turn of events!

title: A Mysterious Missive on Paper Wings
description: It appears that Master Jean needs assistance with something. Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters and see what it is!

title: Glaze Domain, Multum in Parvo
description: After touching the bottle, you really do enter a Domain, but the owner is nowhere to be seen. If you want to find the sender of the "Magic Invite," you'll need to go deep into the Domain...

title: Zip Along (According to Safe Cart Operating Procedures)
description: To repair the great wheel in the Veluriyam Mirage, you must obtain components that have been dropped in different locations. Klee said that a giant canyon appeared in the area they were investigating...

title: Fairground Gathering, Summer Lights Illuminated
description: The third component of the Central Hub fell in the forest to the north. Idyia mentioned that the cousin Eula was searching for has gone to this area as well. Perhaps you'll be able to find something that hints at his whereabouts...

title: Treehouse Theater: Candlelit Shadows Dancing
description: Go look for the last missing part!

title: Back to Normal: The Story Hidden in the Bottle
description: After retrieving all of the components, the Mirage can finally be returned to working order. All that was hidden will be revealed at the hub...

title: Fortress of Meropide
description: At Neuvillette's behest, you are sent to Fortress of Meropide on trumped-up charges to secretly investigate. Your life behind bars is about to begin...

title: Congenial Gathering
description: You hear that Mondstadt and Liyue are hosting a joint event and decide to take a look...

title: Tears Among the Leaves
description: You take a stroll while taking in the scenery for poetic inspiration. As you share your verses with each other, there seems to be a faint sense of sorrow amidst the joyful laughter...

title: Heart of the Deep
description: The fallen leaves float away, carrying with them stories of the past. Will the protagonists of the fairytale rekindle feelings from a distant past?

title: Water Imp's Conjecture
description: Word arrives from the Fishing Association that they seem to have encountered some kind of problem...

title: Prince's Country
description: In order to cure Madame Zuria's child, you begin a fantastical adventure. Today is the day you head to the Kingdom of the Water Imps. Just what will you encounter there?

title: Miraculous Crown
description: The end of the fantastical adventure approaches. At its final destination, will Madame Zuria's child get better, as you all hope?

title: The Crack of Muskets Breaking the Silence
description: During the Fontinalia Festival, children carry baskets and head up and down the streets asking for candies. As you roam the vibrant festive streets, you might just meet some familiar faces...

title: Fiction and Reality Inside and Outside the Frame
description: The film's shooting is going smoothly. The story recorded in the Kamera seems to be being performed somewhere beyond the frame...

title: The Lone Isle Glimpsed Through Fog
description: The lonely isle appeared in silence through the dark fog of night. Wherever shall it lead you...

title: Where the Roses Bloom
description: Where shall the gun barrel of justice point? And who shall the bullet strike...?

title: The Two Musketeers' Triumph
description: This is the day that the winner of the Furina Award shall be revealed at the Fontinalia Film Festival. This is no time for delay. Time to head down to the venue!

title: The Orioles Bask in Spring, the Heavens Present Auspices
description: You and Paimon return to Liyue, preparing to take part in the annual Lantern Rite. As expected, there are familiar faces to be seen as you walk around the harbor...

title: A Cloud-Sea Appeal, a Brilliance Revealed
description: In order to thank you for your help, Gaming proposes to invite you to Xinyue Kiosk for some dim sum...

title: The Glede Returns to the Pavilion
description: Xianyun has hatched a brilliant plan on Gaming's behalf. Now it's time to put it into action...

title: Hustle and Bustle
description: You and Paimon have been at a loose end lately, so you decide to visit Qiaoying Village...

title: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part I
description: One day, you and Paimon pass through Wangshu Inn, only for a notice to attract your attention...

title: Potions Most Potent
description: Lisa seems to be busy with something... for once.

title: A Breakthrough in Craft
description: The alchemy shop has opened, but you and Paimon are dizzyingly busy...

title: International Markets
description: It seems like merchants from other nations have arrived at your shop...

title: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part II
description: After a day's hard work, you and Paimon are now able to deal with the daily kitchen grind. That is, unless some truly picky customers come calling...

title: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part III
description: According to Smiley Yanxiao, you should be fine no matter how tricky the customer. But it seems that his every such utterance tempts fate...

title: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part IV
description: This is your final day of employment as a temporary chef. You wonder if this day will pass by peacefully...

title: The Proscribed, Hidden in Plain Sight
description: Although you met a familiar face, you have obtained no leads on Childe so far. Did you miss something that's hidden in plain sight?

title: A Job Well Done
description: The shop has been a roaring success. Time to celebrate!

title: This Ain't Your Daddy's Iridescence Tour...
description: You've received an invitation from one Arataki Itto. Having been introduced by his enthusiastic letter, you set out on a trip to Watatsumi Island...

title: ...It's the Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness!
description: Thanks to everyone (but especially you), the performance venue is ready at last. It's time for the final celebration...

title: The Story Begins in a Forest Without Rain
description: "They will descend upon the 'Cliff of Prophecy'..."

title: They Once Walked the Starry Sky
description:
"They will descend upon the 'Cliff of Prophecy'..."

Thus would the epics of later generations speak of this time:
The heroes leaped light of foot o'er floral cliffs, trials and tribulations besting forthwith. By their arm they brought forth rain and dew, the dark clouds fled, and flowers grew.

Comment in the margins: You forgot to mention how popular the forest tavern was.
Comment below the comment: Wait, did all of you think the wine was good? I thought it tasted kinda weird.
Comment below the comment below the comment: That might be because someone put... into your cup... (the following words are scratched out)

title: Until the End of the World
description:
"When that time comes, I shall dance, and return the tracks beneath my people's feet back to the stars in the sky..."

Thus would the epics of later generations speak of this time:
The heroes gazed upon the skies of gray, and in carriages bright they went their way. The stars returned and the winds they drove — now the dragon's shadow alone still did rove.
Comment in the margins: I feel that the young nekomata lady in boots who spoke the human tongue needs a line or two!
Comment below the comment: I'll make up for that another day... But really, what did you put into my cup?
Comment below the comment below the comment: I dunno, it wasn't me.
Comment below the comment below the comment: Wasn't me either.

title: Afterword
description:
"The Hero from another world, supported by their companions, shall restore peace to this world..."

Thus would epics of later generations speak of this time:
Thus was the fell dragon saved, thus was peace restored to Simulanka.
The people then lived happily ever after with the cute little dragon named "Durin."
Annoyed comment in the margins: Hey, you're not even bothering to rhyme anymore!

title: Give Her Surprises
description: Sumeru is holding the Sabzeruz Festival! Upon hearing the news, you arrive to see some familiar faces...

title: Give Her Sweetness
description: Some would seek to cause trouble during the festival. They cannot be allowed to ruin this surprise...

title: Give Her Memories
description: When she thinks back on all her birthdays, will this be the most unforgettable?

title: Night-Wind Letter
description: You receive a letter from the Masters of the Night-Wind asking for your help, signed by Ororon. Just what could have happened...

title: Vision of Ashen Desolation
description: In order to help Leyla find his spirit, Citlali plans to get more info from within the tribe, but how successful was she...?

title: The Spirit of Ah K'ulbatil
description: According to Citlali's plan, today's the day to guide Leyla's spirit back to his body. But will everything go off without a hitch...?

title: For Our Saurian Companion
description: Since you've got a free moment, why not take a walk around the Children of Echoes?

title: Medicine Born of Guilt
description: In the first half of the exhibition match, Kachina seems to have something on her mind. Go and ask her about it.

title: Spell of Unity
description: Everyone decided to do something after hearing about how badly the last Bloomflower Trials went, and what happened to the little Qucusaur Antu. However, you'll need help from your other friends...

title: Lost in Deep Seas
description: You've been looking into the Fortress' "hidden rules" and seem to have obtained many leads on Childe. You are certain this trip will not be in vain.

title: Liyue Celebrates and Eight Adepts Face a Hidden Calamity
description: The Lantern Rite has come around once more. What stories will be written in Liyue Harbor this year...

title: The Funeral Parlor Has No Master, Yujing Terrace Calls the Troops
description: The Lantern Rite has come around once more. What stories will be written in Liyue Harbor this year...

title: Qimen Arts and the Rite of Homa, the Spirits are Calmed and Life Restored
description: After two days have passed, you decide to visit the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor to see if Hu Tao has returned...

title: Final Stanza: The Sanctification of Tao Dou
description: Thanks to everyone's efforts, the border crisis has finally been resolved. It seems that Xiangling has something she wants to talk to you about in Liyue Harbor...

title: Business Acumen From the Spina
description: After all is set, you and Paimon turn your attention to learning how to run the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland under Navia's guidance...

title: A Moment's Respite
description: The crisis has been averted... for now. You decide to return to the Fortress of Meropide to see how everyone's doing.

title: As Though Caught in a Dream
description: You receive a long-awaited letter from Yae Miko...

title: As Though Beholding Illusions
description: Strange phenomena have suddenly appeared near the venue for the Mikawa Flower Festival. Dark undercurrents seem to be forming...

title: As Though Surrounded by Thunder
description: The truth behind the doppelgangers and nightmares has been revealed. The actions of the past send ripples through fate, and the events of today blur the line between dreams and reality.

title: As Though Kissed by Dew
description: I know that sweet dreams are as fleeting as the morning dew. And yet...

title: An Overnight Fantasyland
description: Out of a mixture of curiosity and concern, you and Paimon head back to the Court of Fontaine for a stroll around.

title: A Series of Twists and Turns
description: After some time, you decide to return to the Palais Mermonia to check up on your Saurian friend.

title: The Price of Every Price
description: A message arrives from the Palais Mermonia. Seems like it's time to make a move.

title: A Wish For Smooth Sailing
description: Thanks to everyone's hard work, the Film Fantasyland is now in full swing. You finally have some free time to chat with your companions...

title: Covert Investigation, Dirty Money Misdeeds
description: Summer is here, and, following a suggestion from Paimon, you head to Yilong Wharf to sample some refreshing green tea. On your way, you unexpectedly run into Yelan, who appears to be right in the middle of something...

title: Meeting Is Also Parting
description: Acting on intelligence from The Knave, your group arrives at the ruins...

title: An Instant of Intoxication, A Meeting by Moonlight
description: After thoroughly dismantling the Dark Financier's money laundering operations, Yelan can finally take a well-deserved break. She invites you to Fontaine to spend a vacation together...

title: Covert Investigation, Dirty Money Misdeeds
description: The time to act is almost upon you. It's time to head to Yilong Wharf and meet up with Yelan...

title: Covert Investigation, Dirty Money Misdeeds
description: All the clues surrounding the Dark Financier point to the auction. After making your final preparations, you get ready to visit the Hotel Debord...

title: Dun Dun Dunnn! A Major Crisis!
description: As you travel through Nod-Krai, you decide to take a stroll around Nasha Town...

title: Those Strange and Intriguing Questions
description: You seem to have caught wind of some Akademiya researchers arguing in Port Ormos. Might as well listen in and find out what's going on, right?

title: Boong Boong Bwoooom! A Grand Plot!
description: The appointed time has arrived. You move to investigate the illegal black market...

title: Boom Boom Boooom! A Grand Battle!
description: The time you agreed upon with Jahoda has arrived. You wonder if she brings good news...

title: Ding Ding Dinggg! A Great Feast!
description: The troubled days have come to an end. You and Paimon decide to pay Aino another visit...

title: Hunters, Prophets
description: You return to the Spina di Rosula base in Fleuve Cendre, and there, you meet an unexpected friend...

title: Return From the Mysterious Realm
description: Returning to Sumeru, you and Paimon run into some old friends...

title: Headlong Into the Sands
description: The appointed time has come. Seek out the truth in the sea of sand.

title: Dodoco's Bomb-Rally Ruckus
description: Klee has picked out her favorite toy...

title: An Adventurer's Woes
description: To provide assistance to Nod-Krai's adventurers, the Adventurers' Guild has also placed an order with Aino...

title: A Mysterious Outsourced Contract
description: It seems the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau has business with Aino...

title: Backup Plans
description: Aino's working on a backup plan to save her friends...

title: The Shining Warriors Take the Stage
description: As the white snow flutters down, you return to the foot of Dragonspine...

title: Promise You Won't Waste Your Youth
description: A shared hobby brings you all together...

title: Now's No Time for Tears
description: "Some people think I'm not enough. I have two words for those people: Think again."

title: Apocalypse
description: The prophecy shall inevitably come to fruition, and the plans are all in place. All that's left... is to judge a god.

title: Go, Fietena, Go!
description: Now's the time to run for your dreams, give it everything you've got!

title: A Little Walk Home
description: Yaoyao and Qiqi are preparing snacks and drinks...

title: The Realm of Clouds
description: The Lantern Rite is here. What new changes await in Liyue Harbor this year?

title: The Realm of Rocks
description: The Lantern Rite is here. What new changes await in Liyue Harbor this year?

title: The Realm of People
description: The Lantern Rite is here. What new changes await in Liyue Harbor this year?

title: The Infamous Merc Captain
description: Jahoda reminds you that the person you're about to meet on the giant ship is an infamous merc captain who sails the high seas. You had best act with caution...

title: The Top Dog of the Criminal Underworld
description: Jahoda warns you that the individual staying at The Flagship is a top dog of the criminal underworld. You'd do well to stay on their good side...

title: The Workshop Owner With a Sweet Tooth
description: Jahoda informs you that the booth reserved for Aino has been sitting empty for too long. You'd better get her here lickety-split.

title: The Forest Boar and the Little Witch
description: After experiencing many things, you decide to go to Aisa Bathhouse to relax a bit...

title: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind
description: You receive an invitation from the Knights of Favonius...

title: Deluge of Wrathful Waters
description: This is the day you get out of prison, and you proceed to complete the paperwork for your release as arranged.

title: For a Reunion Without Tears
description: Alice has used her magic to conjure a bubble that recreate your Mondstadt travels so the story can be shared with the knights who have returned from their expedition. As someone who has experienced it firsthand, you gladly agree to test and check it in advance...

title: Variations on the Song of the Dragon and Freedom
description: The second day's tests have come to a successful close. After a joyful banquet, the third day finally arrives. It's time to test the story's ending...

title: Hunting Training
description: Prune seems to be busy taking notes...

title: A Commission From the Curatorium of Secrets
description: Out of the blue, you receive a letter from the Curatorium of Secrets. Nefer seems to have a commission that only you can handle...

title: Encirclement of Bullets and Silk
description: The criminal puppetmaster lurking in the shadows has finally taken the bait. Yelan from Liyue's Ministry of Civil Affairs and Chevreuse from Fontaine's Maison Gardiennage have embarked on a rare joint operation. However, apprehending the perpetrator isn't the only issue they have to ponder...

title: Toys for the Children
description: With Yelan's help, you locate Ashvapati's hideout. There lies a past buried beneath the yellow sands, and with it, the truth behind the entire case...

title: Return Home, Children of the Desert
description: The case has finally been resolved. However, when the question of how to deal with Ashvapati arises, everyone appears to have a different opinion...

title: The Opera of Noirceur and Blancheur
description: Whether it be the "Focalors" before Neuvillette, or the "Furina" before you, they are performing the same opera, and the final truth is hidden within it...

title: If You Should Forget the Entrance to Dreams
description: The Dough King and its kin have come to the little witches' secret base, and they even bring new clues with them...

title: The Magic That Never Fails
description: Thanks to everyone's efforts, you've made progress in the operation to save the imaginary friend...

title: Gena's Great Escape
description: Sayu's fallen asleep again?

title: Should We Meet Again
description: The Fontinalia Film Festival is coming up. Why not head back to Fontaine? You might just run into some old friends there.

title: Those We Have Lost
description: Before meeting her friends, she seems intent on resolving "anomalies" within herself first...

title: Those We Have Kept
description: Now that she has been "born anew," what will she choose to do next...?

title: Those We Have Kept
description: The film premiere is a success, and she seems to have changed much...

title: Finale
description: The calamity facing Fontaine has finally come to an end. No matter what happens, the presses won't stop churning news out. In other words, the people will learn about the truth as fast as The Steambird's staffers can write it.

title: Liyue Game
description: A mysterious man calling himself the Cricket Referee excitedly invites you to play a game popular with the masses in Liyue.

title: Pontoon Parkour
description: At Cider Lake, a woman explained her troubles to you.

title: Slime Baskets
description: An enthusiastic slime breeder invites you to play with them.

title: One Giant Step for Alchemy?
description: In an effort to hone his alchemical skills, Timaeus has designed an all-new alchemical furnace. There's just one problem — he needs some help to get it working...

title: Unknown Star
description: Katheryne of the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild seems to have something to tell you.

title: The Crisis Deepens
description: As your investigation proceeds, you gradually realize that there is some mysterious power hidden within these meteorites. In order to help the victims regain consciousness, you and your comrades begin to dispose of meteorites throughout the land...

title: What the Skies Conceal, the Water Reveals
description: Apart from the spate of unconsciousness caused by the meteorites, the appearance of the Fatui has also aroused your suspicions. Fortunately, the arrival of the astrologist Mona has given your efforts a much-needed boost. With the help of her mystical scrying techniques, you begin to delve into these mysteries...

title: Where Ancient Stars Align
description: The meteorites that have rained down were once, in fact, part of someone's constellation. Why did this ancient array of stars fall from the sky? What goal were their extinguished flames chasing? Armed with the courage to face the answers, you march onward.

title: That Which Fell From the Sky
description: Due to the constant descent of meteorites from the sky, it has become too unsafe to go outside. Sister Grace is very worried about those people who linger out there in the wild...

title: Good Hunter Express
description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...

title: To Each Their Duty
description: Even though rocks are falling from the skies, some Knights of Favonius are still attending to their duties outside the city. Huffman is rather worried about these knights...

title: Contingencies
description: Huffman is currently so busy with matters concerning the fallen meteorites, that he barely has time for anything else...

title: "That Guy"'s Scheme
description: The fallen meteorites have turned Mondstadt upside down, inside and out. But it seems that the mysterious Vile is looking for people to help her out with a little something...

title: Meteorites and Adventure
description: Jack from the Adventurers' Guild seems to have some ideas on what to do about those fallen meteorites...

title: Trouble With Letters
description: Due to the meteor shower, Jiayi's plans to return home to see his family have been canceled yet again. He is looking for someone to send a letter to Qingce Village...

title: A Mysterious Loss
description: Many meteorites have landed outside the city of Mondstadt, wreaking havoc everywhere. Viktor appears to have lost something important, and is talking to himself, flummoxed...

title: The Siege of Qingce
description: The Millelith soldier Jinglun is fretting about how to defeat the monsters around Qingce Village...

title: Unlimited Opportunity
description: Ivanovich is getting ideas about what business might be done regarding those fallen meteorites...

title: Thoughts Carried On the Wind
description: The meteor shower out in the wild seems to have left Godwin all in a fluster...

title: Wangshu Take-Away
description: Wangshu Inn has a special order that needs sending out...

title: Wanmin Fresh
description: Wanmin Restaurant has taken a custom order that now awaits delivery...
