description: Wanmin Restaurant has taken a custom order that now awaits delivery...

title: Fly High
description: The adventurer Hughes is a wind glider fanatic. To that end, he travels the world, constantly polishing his gliding skills. Recently, he seems to have discovered several prime gliding spots...

title: Festering Desire
description: After your journey up Dragonspine, you and Paimon prepare to head back to the adventurer camp in the foothills to have a look.

title: Archon's Rival
description: As Albedo suspected, this sword can absorb power to display a facsimile of "growth." This rare ability has caused it to catch the eye of certain parties with ulterior motives.

title: Raiders Amidst Snow Mist
description: All proceeds smoothly. You plan to search for Albedo to discuss the changes the sword has undergone further.

title: Uninvited Guests
description: Many unexpected things have happened on this mountain. A mysterious hidden camp, suddenly-appearing thieves, uninvited enemies... This sword seems to have brought you into the thick of all this weirdness. So long as it remains in your hands, trouble will always follow in its wake — with such troubles including those who have come to take the sword, and new monsters heretofore unseen.

title: Afterword
description: After a long battle, the sword that has, at last, completed its growth has a new place to be.

title: The Origin of the Lanterns
description: On the day of the first full moon each year, the people of Liyue celebrate Lantern Rite. At nighttime, everyone in Liyue releases Xiao Lanterns and the Mingxiao Lantern into the bright night sky. Each Xiao Lantern contains a piece of Plaustrite that makes it float, and people hang wish sticks from them, which carry their hearts' desires in written or painted form. The lanterns slowly fly away, carrying the hope that the light they emit might guide the souls of Liyue's faithful protectors home, that they might return and be reunited with their people once more. You and Paimon arrive in Liyue as the festival is in full swing, preparing to enjoy yourselves...

title: Currents Deep Beneath the Lanterns
description: The highlight of Lantern Rite is the release of the giant Mingxiao Lantern into the sky, and this year's Mingxiao Lantern is supposed to be a sight well worth the wait. The Plaustrite that will lift the lantern into the air is the largest in twenty years! For this special occasion, the merchants of Liyue have set up the Xiao Market to help gather the materials needed to build the lantern. When you arrive at the Xiao Market, one of the event organizers, Wang'ya, seems to have something to say to you...

title: Light Upon the Sea
description: Lantern Rite is still ongoing. With the help of Xiao, Kaeya, and the Millelith, you have foiled a "plot" that has left you not knowing whether to laugh or cry and have succeeded in bringing the foolish criminal behind it to justice and handing them over to the Millelith. Today, you prepare to go to Wangshu Inn to report the results of the matter to Xiao, as you agreed...

title: Qingce's Lanterns
description: Something seems to be bothering Granny Ruoxin from Qingce Village...

title: Keeping Wanmin's Patrons Fed
description: Once again, it's the Lantern Rite — and once again, Wanmin Restaurant's Chef Mao is busier than ever...

title: Iron Ingot Meets Ziwei
description: Iron Ingot from Liyue Harbor seems to be troubled about something...

title: Lantern Rite, Big Business?
description: Mr. Zhu seems to want to use the Lantern Rite to pick his business up a little...

title: Verses and Vistas of Lantern Rite (Part I)
description: The artist Vermeer is puzzling over how to capture the Lantern Rite in a painting...

title: Outspoken Linling
description: Linling from Liyue Harbor seems to be troubled by something...

title: Yesteryear's Lanterns and the Guhua of Today
description: Sun Yu and Little Que'er seem to want to release a Xiao Lantern...

title: A Festive First Adventure
description: Tiantian of the Liyue Adventurers' Guild seems to have been working on something...

title: A Very Festive Problem
description: Bubu Pharmacy's Herbalist Gui is racking his brains about something...

title: Little Lantern, Little Wish
description: Mengmeng seems to be troubled by something...

title: Hammer and Wrench
description: Wrench Wang from Liyue Harbor seems to be looking for help with some matters...

title: Mondstadters in Liyue
description: Freki and Geri are getting a little homesick...

title: The Illumiscreen: I
description: Brother Qian from the Liyue Adventurers' Guild is inviting people to play a certain game...

title: The Illumiscreen: II
description: Brother Qian from the Liyue Adventurers' Guild is still inviting people to try playing with the Illumiscreen...

title: The Illumiscreen: III
description: Brother Qian from the Liyue Adventurers' Guild is still inviting people to try playing with the Illumiscreen...

title: Kurious Kamera
description: A certain special Kamera is currently causing Ji Tong some grief...

title: Perfect Shot
description: Ji Tong from Liyue Harbor seems to have found a way to fix that Kamera of his...

title: Ode to Flower and Cloud
description: When you've got some leisure time, how about taking a stroll through Mondstadt's streets and seeing if there's anything to do?

title: Missive of Cloud and Fog
description: As Venti's all-important assistant, you are to go out with him to collect the love poetry written by the people of Mondstadt. However, the citizenry has various troubles of their own, even during such a festive time as this.

title: Realm of Fog and Wind
description: You and Venti keep pushing on for the sake of some good wine. Cold corners, perilous places, strange sites... who knows what incidents await the two of you? Even more interestingly, you begin to realize that there is no common understanding of what a "Windblume" is.

title: Dream of Wind and Flowers
description: On account of your contributions to Mondstadt, you have been chosen as this year's Windblume Star. As such, you will be making a Windblume offering to the Anemo Archon, Barbatos, on behalf of the whole of Mondstadt. That said, what on earth is a Windblume?

title: Life Flows On (I)
description: The water source near the winery has become bitter for no apparent reason. The Adventurers' Guild hopes for your cooperation in resolving this matter.

title: Life Flows On (II)
description: After having helped Endora for this period of time, you are finally ready to cut to the heart of this problem.

title: Break the Sword Cemetery Seal
description: According to Dr. Livingstone, there are three hilichurl tribes surrounding the Sword Cemetery in <color=#00E1FFFF>Dadaupa Gorge</color>. To the north, the Meaty tribe; to the south, the Sleeper tribe; and in the valley to the east, the Eclipse tribe. The key to breaking the seals on the Sword Cemetery may lie within their encampments...

title: Break the Eclipse Tribe's Seal
description: The Eclipse tribe's Elemental Monument stands at the center of their dilapidated altar. It is being defended by samachurls, mitachurls and Abyss Mages, so it might be best to find a way to pick them off.

title: Break the Sleeper Seal
description: The Sleeper tribe's power lies beneath a large tree, defended by mitachurls and a heap of hilichurls. Defeating mitachurls will break the seal on the Elemental Monument. It is said that mitachurls sleep early, so surprising them at night might be a good idea.

title: Break the Meaty Seal
description: The Meaty tribe worships power. Challenge them in the arena to break the seal.

title: Find the Missing Fairy
description: The fairies were kidnapped by nearby hilichurls, devastating the Tree of Life. If we manage to save the fairies, perhaps the Tree of Life will respond to our prayers.

title: Mondstadt Glider
description: As it turned out, the book Amber gave you wasn't a manual, but a fairy tale... After completing the first test out in the wild, you learn that the second test is to take place within the city of Mondstadt itself. Amber is waiting for you there.

title: Amber Abyss
description: Set the Fallen Afloat

title: Wolves' Territory
description: You and Paimon decide to pay a visit to Wolvendom, a place in Mondstadt that few people pass through, without any knowledge of the dangers that may await you within this primordial territory.

title: Another Day as an Outrider!
description: On your last legs from being attacked by an enormous slime, you were rescued by a young man named Razor. Razor, who calls a wolf pack family, mentioned a "red one, burny girl." You have your guesses as to who that is...

title: Ravaged by Wolves
description: It seems that the "red, burny girl" was not Amber, as you had thought. But you receive news from Amber about wolf pack attacks in Drunkard Gorge. The wolf pack, the boy, the attacks... things are getting more complicated. This calls for a thorough investigation.

title: Fate's Chosen Lupical
description: You are yet again led to Wolvendom. Are these Wolfhook seeds solid evidence? Are Razor and his wolf pack really behind the attack? Or are the Wolfhooks indicative of something else?

title: Kaeya's Troubles
description: You bump into Kaeya, whom you first met during Stormterror's attack, at the Knights of Favonius Headquarters.

title: Mystery of the Arcadian Ruins
description: According to Kaeya, his pirate grandfather left behind a treasured sword that has been buried in the Lost Arcadian Ruins. To prevent it from falling into the wrong hands, you search high and low for intelligence regarding the ruins.

title: Kaeya's Gain
description: After much thinking, you finally solve the riddles contained within the intel you were given. The Lost Arcadian Ruins are now within reach!

title: Legend of the Darknight Hero
description: Recently, rumors about a certain Darknight Hero have been circulating around Mondstadt...

title: Darknight Hero's Crisis
description: Your inquiries were slowly bringing the Darknight Hero's identity to light, but just then, you met the man himself. His true identity is Diluc, owner of the Dawn Winery — and his actions have long since attracted the attention of the Knights of Favonius...

title: Darknight Hero's Alibi
description: Knight Huffman has informed you that the Abyss Order is plotting against the Darknight Hero. As a precaution, the Knights have decided to monitor the Darknight Hero's actions. You shared this information with Diluc and discussed countermeasures. Having made your preparations, you now lie in wait for both the Knights and the Abyss Order to act.

title: The Art of Cooking
description: On the outskirts of the city of Mondstadt, the adventurer Lynn is currently preparing to make a meal...

title: The Boars are Attacking!
description: Boars keep attacking the vineyards, and Tunner is getting anxious...

title: The Blessings of The Seven
description: Paimon suggests you go to a Statue of The Seven.

title: Scent on the Wind
description: As you walk through Mondstadt, Paimon is attracted by the aroma of food...

title: License to Glide
description: Amber has specially prepared a gliding exam for you. She has also provided a gliding manual, which she has asked you to read before taking the exam.

title: Glide With the Wind
description: Amber wishes to discuss the matter of how you've been using your wind glider...

title: Gliding Training at Windrise
description: Gliding Bombardment Minigame

title: They Call Him Raptor
description: During the exam, you were mistaken for the thief Raptor by Otto, a Knight of Favonius, and were stopped. After clearing the misunderstanding, you volunteer to help arrest Raptor — and so begins the chase.

title: Outrider Style
description: During your pursuit, you track Raptor to his hideout. You plunge into its depths without hesitation. Time to bring this criminal to justice.

title: When the West Wind Arises
description: Sara from the Good Hunter restaurant appears to have a request for the Knights of Favonius...

title: Margaret's Longing
description: While Jean is ill from overwork, you've been tasked with handling some citizens' commissions on her behalf. Where has Margaret's pet cat Prince run off to this time?

title: Charles' Troubles
description: Has Charles managed to get hold of the tax forms he needs?

title: Sara's Worries
description: Sara's delivery of ingredients still hasn't arrived, and she's growing more anxious by the minute...

title: Master's Day Off
description: Today's commissions are done and dusted. Time to check up on Jean at the Cathedral.

title: Natlan! A New Adventure
description: You've made many unforgettable memories in Fontaine. Now, a new journey lies before you — first, time to say goodbye to your fine Fontainian friends.

title: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
description: The Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame, the most important competition in Natlan, is about to begin. Meet up with Kachina and the gang before things start.

title: Home of the Hot Springs
description: As the Pilgrimage draws to a close, Kachina emerges triumphant, and she joins the Night Warden Wars alongside some seasoned veterans. After the tournament, Mualani moots the idea of visiting the People of the Springs...

title: A Decision
description: You make new friends amongst the People of the Springs and leave memories behind. It's good to take a break before embarking on a new journey.

title: To Reclaim an Ancient Name
description: To rescue Kachina, who has been trapped in the Night Kingdom, you must first seek out her Ancient Name. Kinich says that he has given the ritual implements needed to do so to the Chief of the Scions of the Canopy. Head there and ask around.

title: Echoes of Life
description: You've successfully obtained Kachina's Ancient Name. Now, hand it to Mavuika.

title: Into Eternal Night
description: After passing through the dragon ruins, you reach the Night Kingdom at last. Time to search for Kachina.

title: Past and Future
description: Mavuika's spirit enters the Night Kingdom at a critical moment to extract everyone. She seems to still be at the Speaker's Chamber. Time to go visit her.

title: Beneath the Secret Source
description: After several twists and turns, you finally understand The Captain's plan and goal — to "reconstruct the Ley Lines." This seems to you a risky endeavor. One for which countermeasures must be discussed with Mavuika post-haste...

title: As One We Watch the Setting Sun
description: You witness the emergence of the fifth hero within the Remnants of the Secret Source, and temporary cooperation with The Captain is established. It seems this matter has drawn to a close, and yet the Abyss presses in. It's not time to relax just yet...

title: The Surging Darkness
description: Abyssal monsters invade Natlan, and the curtain rises on a massive war...

title: Despair Engulfs the Heavens
description: The true master of the Abyssal power has emerged at last. The earth's corrosion intensifies and monsters are driven mad, the apocalyptic scene becoming a festering seedbed of impotent despair.

title: No One Fights Alone
description: The six heroes have gathered, and Mavuika awakens the power of the divine throne. The horn is sounded for all Natlan to hear — the Night War is underway! A reckoning has come for the Abyss!

title: A Fuel Named "Fate"
description: The threat to Natlan remains unresolved, for the Abyssal tide you shattered was but a reflection emerging from the Night Kingdom. Still more crises await — sorrow, solitude, and death...

title: All Names Are Noble
description: Your adventures in Natlan continue. After some time has passed...

title: To Whence the Smoke Drifts
description: Citlali comes as promised, but she also makes a request: she wants you to help her find her missing grandson, Ororon. You take this commission and set out alongside her.

title: The Flickering Light Splits in Twain
description: The Abyss is invading, and the situation grows dire. Everyone has their mission, and here and now, you decide to first speak to Mavuika about the key information you've obtained...

title: Subterranean Ruins
description: The crucial moment is fast approaching. You should get some rest today...

title: As the Sun Rises and Sets
description: The time for the meeting has finally come. Head over to the Speaker's Chamber.

title: Journey of Stars and Flames
description: The final battle with the Abyss is at hand. You have the support of all in Natlan, and they will do so in various ways. Once you are ready, journey forth to the last battleground.

title: For the Same Land
description: After the routing of the black sun that had hung high in the sky, Natlan finally had a precious moment of respite. You decide to go help the Flower-Feather Clan, which had been hit hardest by the calamity, with their reconstruction efforts...

title: Where All Hopes Lie
description: With the aid of your companions, you and Mavuika finally get the chance to face off against Gosoythoth. Give your all to claim victory, and by doing so, end the war in Natlan.

title: When All Becomes a Monument
description: Side by side with Mavuika, you defeat Gosoythoth and emerge as a hero revered by all in Natlan. Take this moment to enjoy the glory that is rightfully yours.

title: After the Peace
description: Tonight, you hear a familiar voice in your dreams...

title: A New Pilgrimage
description: At Iansan's request, you and Mavuika help test the competition process...

title: Hearken, Ye Who Have Returned
description: Natlan's very first leader, the mighty first Pyro Archon Xbalanque, has appeared before all in a form and manner beyond imagination...

title: Crimes One and Two
description: The Windblume Festival should be a joyous affair, but not all is as it seems in Mondstadt...

title: Where the Moon Rises
description: Moonlight paves your way, guiding you to Nod-Krai, an "elysium" for adventurers and wanderers alike...

title: Reunion Beneath the Moonlight
description: The secrets of this land are like an ancient song that lingers in your heart and cannot be easily dismissed... What song shall Nod-Krai play for you this night...?

title: In the Shadows of Night
description: Ever do ominous mists rise at night, and ever will perilous schemes brew in the darkness...

title: Moonless Night
description: A battle for the fate of your companions and Nod-Krai has already begun...

title: Flamelets
description: Natlan seems to have welcomed some unexpected guests...

title: Smoldering
description: In order to cure Ineffa's amnesia, everyone searches Natlan for answers...

title: Searing
description: It seems this ancient place has been waiting for your arrival...

title: Fulminations and Undercurrents
description: The Wild Hunt has left many secrets behind, and the shadows hidden within the Abyss begin to churn. After chaos strikes, unease spreads amongst people, making them desperate for solutions...

title: The Dark Side of Memory
description: After repairing the giant cannon and successfully dispersing the Wild Hunt, you make for Hiisi Island to attempt to get some clarity regarding the memories of your spaceship.

title: One There Was, Who Hunted the Moon
description: With The Damselette, you not only uncover surprising truths from your memories but also learn the true identity of the phantom masquerading as your sibling. He may well be one of the Five Sinners Dainsleif once mentioned — Rerir, the Rächer of Solnari.

title: The Hunger of Many
description: Everything comes to an end, all too abruptly. Without a shred of hesitation, you throw yourself into the fray along with everyone else...

title: The Ashen-White Order Burns
description: You and Flins discover that the cannon's firing is Rerir's doing, but his motives remain a mystery. Either way, you are running out of time...

title: Rest Beyond Reach
description: Rerir used the cannon in Nasha Town to obtain a complete body. The chaos caused by the Wild Hunt is far from over...

title: Hidden in the Shadows
description: The "Rächer of Solnari" has been revived with the aid of a kuuvahki beam. Now a new crisis looms over Nod-Krai...

title: Special Operation
description: Grand Master Varka has returned from Amsvartnir and helped to devise a battle plan. To face the "Rächer of Solnari," the people of Nod-Krai must unite as never before...

title: Everlasting As the Moon
description: After negotiating with Sandrone, the "Marionette," you leave the Fatui's Experimental Design Bureau. Everywhere you look, the Wild Hunt is prowling. Make your way back to base — and be sure not to get caught along the way!

title: The First Sliver of Moonlight
description: The bright moon hangs high, casting down its gentle light. Yet, your stories begin to flow down different paths...

title: Descending Moon
description: Through the endless, long night, The Doctor's schemes press closer, step by relentless step...

title: Welkin Moon's Homecoming
description: The moon has returned to its homeland. Under its silver glow, Nod-Krai will set forth toward a bright, new tomorrow...

title: All Is Foretold
description: Back at base, everyone is discussing what to do next. Then, an unexpected figure enters the conversation.

title: Dance of Death: Serpent and Scorpion
description: By means of a special ceremony, you finally learn about the "Rächer of Solnari" Rerir's past.\nNow all that's left is to leave this place.

title: The Gardener
description: Following the principles of "truth," people gain knowledge, learn of boundaries, and nurture reverence. This mindset provides a safe borderline — while also shackling the mad.

title: Echoes of Fate
description: To stop the Rächer of Solnari from causing further harm to Nod-Krai, you must gather all your strength and prepare for the most important battle.

title: Where Our Space and Time Intersect
description: In this unfamiliar world, with companions beyond reach... What path is there to take that leads back to their side?

title: Tracing the Footsteps of the Past
description: Beneath the moon's watchful light, everyone is marching to the conclusions of their own stories...

title: Where Does Her Name Rest?
description: Seek her name within the boundless sea called "the past"...

title: In the Shifting Light of the Moon
description: The journey so far has reached a brief pause. Take a moment to rest and check in on your companions.

title: Ripples That Will Never Reach
description: After reaching an understanding, you decide to head back to the Silvermoon Hall to ask around about what kind of gifts Columbina likes.

title: The Night the Moon Returns Home
description: The Moon-Prayer Night has come. On this final night, what memories will she leave behind?

title: Return to the Moon
description: It's time to begin the journey home...

title: Darkness Looming
description: The situation in Sumeru is even more dire than first thought, and people have come together to come up with plans for various contingencies.

title: A Tower Unto Wisdom and Folly
description: The current crisis is now beyond the capacity of ordinary men, and an unprecedented war is about to begin in the nation of wisdom. But even so, no one is abandoning their post.

title: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
description: "The girl dreamed a very, very long dream. In it, people were holding hands, dancing in a circle, be they sages or fools, dancers or warriors, puppets or statues of gods... It did not matter who they were, or how old, and in that joyous dancing circle was the sum of all wisdom."

title: Your Past Is Like a Garden
description: The life of sentient beings seems destined to be a treacherous road. Yet, the warm and gentle sunshine still illuminates us who look upon one another. Yet deep and enduring love exists that can help us find ourselves again. And after the crisis passes, the flowers will be there to embrace you.

title: Windblume Research Report
description: The ever-studious researcher, Sayid from Sumeru, has become intrigued by the Windblume Festival.

title: The Sound of Discord
description: Vile has caught wind of some concerning news and would like you to go and investigate.

title: Those Hard-to-Reach Places
description: Knight of Favonius Aramis is worried about the flower petals blowing all over the place...

title: Mutual Exchange
description: You go with Ella Musk to communicate with the hilichurls. Perhaps this might be the start of a new friendship...?

title: "Quiet, please, this is a library!"
description: Ella Musk is trying to study in the library, but it seems something is disrupting her...

title: Windbrew
description: Margaret from The Cat's Tail seems to be planning something...

title: Windblumes and Snowflakes
description: Viktor seems to have run into a small issue during the Windblume Festival.

title: Adventurers in Windblume
description: Iris, who has set up shop at the Dragonspine base camp, seems to want some help...

title: Hilichurl Justice
description: You prepare to help a bullied hilichurl to even the score together with Ella Musk. With any luck, this may lead you to some new clues...

title: Mutual Exchange
description: You go with Ella Musk to communicate with the hilichurls. Perhaps this might be the start of a new friendship...?

title: Hilichurl Justice
description: You prepare to help a bullied hilichurl to even the score together with Ella Musk. With any luck, this may lead you to some new clues...

title: Mutual Exchange
description: You go with Ella Musk to communicate with the hilichurls. Perhaps this might be the start of a new friendship...?

title: Mimi Tomo
description: The Adventurers' Guild has issued a new commission, and it seems to be related to a certain "Unusual Hilichurl"...?

title: The Lost Hilichurl
description: The unusual fellow may have gotten away in the end, but at least the merchant route is safe again.

title: Journey to Tsurumi
description: Katheryne of the Adventurers' Guild is currently puzzling over a certain commission...

title: Autonomous Mechanical Energy Source: Preface
description: After some searching, you have found some components. Time to discuss your findings with Hosseini.

title: Autonomous Mechanical Energy Source: Live Sample
description: The calibration work on Pursina's Spikes went quite smoothly indeed. Now it's time to see them in action.

title: Autonomous Mechanical Energy Source: Conclusion
description: With Hosseini's help, you successfully defeated that unique autonomous machine. Inform him of the good news.

title: Tuned to the World's Sounds
description: The Alcor's Chief Mate Juza is looking for you at the Liyue Harbor wharf. Seems that he needs your help with something...

title: A Very Fishy Encounter
description: In waters south of Lumidouce Harbor, you encounter a rather peculiar individual who calls herself an "Unchained Hunter." She's currently in the midst of doing everything she can to contain an impending ecological crisis...

title: Qiaoying, the Village of Many Tales
description: You once again meet the slightly paranoid author, Guijarro, in Qiaoying Village...

title: Begin Adventure Zone
description: Begin Adventure Zone

title: Bar Brawl
description: Bar Brawl

title: Chase the Masked Performer
description: Chase the Masked Performer

title: Town Celebration
description: Town Celebration

title: Forest Boar Pauses for the Bloom
description: ...Near the flower field of Millhaven, now left in disarray, you notice a woman sighing in frustration. A brief exchange reveals the cause of the chaos — a forest boar has been trampling the flowers...

title: The Wind Has Ceased
description: There's an abandoned sanatorium on Windrest Peak...

title: Alan Smithee, Author of Fischl: Epilogue
description: Now that you've learned Mr. Nine's secret, it's time to deliver the hidden royalties to Chang the Ninth...

title: Unofficial Chronicle of the Desert Pavilion
description: There appears to be a survivor who's escaped punishment at the Desert Pavilion...

title: Unexpected Commission: Epilogue
description: Now that Lisa's commission is complete, you'd better ask her for your payment...

title: Stories to Sate the Glass and Scroll
description: Witch's Homework was born from discussions between Varka and the witches. The task assigned to Varka himself appears to be...

title: Winds Beneath the Tower of Silence
description: You learned in the tavern that the alarm at Dornman Port's old lighthouse seems to be malfunctioning. Rumors say that it's caused by ghosts beneath the lighthouse...

title: Tea Party Re-Invitation: Albedo
description: Go to Dragonspine, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Albedo...

title: A Proposition Beyond Refutation
description: Inside the witch's dictionary, you discover a rather infantile "declaration of war"...

title: Proof of Strength
description: What can serve as a symbol of one's power...?

title: The Wind Has Ceased
description: There's an abandoned sanatorium on Windrest Peak...

title: The Festering Fang
description: You picked up a strange dragon tooth while adventuring in Dragonspine. Perhaps you should ask around and see if someone knows anything more about it...

title: The Great Mountain Survey
description: The environmentalist Esther and the expedition team with her were set upon by monsters while performing a mountain survey, with the larger part of her survey beacons being lost in the process. She is currently looking for someone who can get them back for her...

title: Ah, Fresh Meat!
description: Harris, the chef at the foothill camp, has received inspiration from an ancient recipe and would like to create an all-new gourmet dish. For this, he first requires 10 servings of Chilled Meat...

title: Low-Temperature Warning
description: Iris has a warning for you regarding Dragonspine's low temperatures...

title: The Great Mountain Survey II
description: Though the beacons have all been placed, Esther remains unable to measure Dragonspine's true height, seemingly due to having insufficient beacons. To resolve the issue, she is looking for someone who can help her plant a beacon directly at the mountain's summit...

title: Go to Snezhnaya
description: Set out for Snezhnaya.

title: A Chat in the Snowy Mountains
description: Go to Dragonspine, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Albedo...

title: Sudden Encounter in the Shadow Realm
description: While adventuring in Snezhnaya, you suddenly encountered something strange.

title: A Land Entombed
description: You discover a strange journal in the mountains that tells of the secrets of a certain kingdom. Perhaps someone at the camp may know more about this journal...

title: Lost in the Snow
description: Joel asks you to ahead into the mountain to look for his father, who has yet to return from an adventure of his own...

title: In the Mountains
description: At the adventurer camp, Iris informs you that there seems to be some bizarrely hard ice blocking the paths into the mountain...

title: When the Trail Goes Cold
description: The Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild appears to be recruiting adventurers for a new and ambitious adventure...

title: Contraption-Contrived Cooking Course: Part III
description: Cloud Retainer is preparing to use the "Supreme Cuisine Machine" to make three all-new dishes...

title: Contraption-Contrived Cooking Course: Part II
description: Cloud Retainer seems to want to use this "Supreme Cuisine Machine" to create a new dish...

title: Of Drink A-Dreaming
description: Angel's Share seems to have started hosting some special event recently...

title: Solid Ice, Soluble in Wine
description: "Tsk, why is a Lawrence drinking here too... What bad luck..." "Ahem... Better watch your mouth. She is one of the Knights, after all..."

title: When They Take Off Their Armor
description: "Has anyone seen Captain Kaeya?" "Kaeya? you'll find him in the tavern. Hehe... You must be new here, no? Well, good luck!"

title: Fine Wine From Yesterday
description: "Just now, I saw Master Diluc enter the tavern in a rush." "Oh? Is Master Diluc going to mix drinks personally today? Can't miss out on this one... Come on, help me up."

title: Dandelion, Rose, and Windwheel Aster
description: "What on earth happened that Acting Grand Master Jean is going to the tavern?" "Calm down, it's the Acting Grand Master we're talking about. Besides, she wouldn't be there if something bad were really going on."

title: Surrounded by the Aroma of Tea
description: "There seems to be a very unusual customer in the tavern..." "Well, it isn't every day that someone piques your interest. How about we go check this person out together?" "Forget it... I wouldn't dare to utter a word in front of him even if I went."

title: Docked on a Moonlit Night
description: "Do you know that I met a very nice client today? She moved and talked with grace — a very generous buyer, too." "What did you sell her?" "Trade secret."

title: Untainted Autumn Frost
description: "Is the white-haired lady passing by an adeptus from Liyue?" "I can't tell. Can you?" "Me, neither..."

title: Of Drink A-Dreaming: Afterword
description: "Bartender Academy Week" has come to an end. It is time to bid farewell to Luka.

title: Phantom of the Past
description: The weather is starting to get hot. Paimon wants to buy some fruit juice from Dawn Winery to cool off...

title: All's Well That Ends Well
description: You and Paimon patrolled the area near the abnormal ley line deposit for several days. It is time now, it seems, to report back to Adelinde.

title: Evermotion Mechanical Painting
description: Félix Yogue, a person from the Court of Fontaine, seems to be having some problems...

title: Evermotion Mechanical Painting: Finale
description: Félix Yogue, someone from the Court of Fontaine, still seems to have things he wants to say...

title: Any Unsolved Mysteries?
description: Paimon suddenly has a mysterious feeling and suggests that you take another trip to the Golden Apple Archipelago to have a close look around...

title: Charity Event? Securing Funds?
description: Bernhard, a Knight of Favonius, appears to have encountered some trouble this Weinlesefest...

title: Favonian Goodies
description: After going through a fair bit of effort, the starting capital for your charitable activities has been obtained. It's time to open for business...

title: Favonian Goodies and Buddies
description: Favonian Goodies has caught the eye of many, and some good-hearted shopkeepers would like to pitch in and help out...

title: Charity Event! A Great Success!
description: The charity event is coming to an end. Hope all the effort has paid off...

title: Beverage Shop on the Pier
description: Quqing, the owner of the new beverage shop on the northern pier of Liyue Harbor, seems to be asking for help...

title: Mountain Mixologist
description: Chef Guanchui, who has just recently returned to Qingce Village, seems to be worried about his friend's thirst-quenching drinks...

title: A Visitor From Westward Realms: The Flavor of Freedom
description: A certain person from Sumeru is currently discussing something with Sara...

title: Floral Pursuit
description: Plauen of the Adventurers' Guild seems to be busy with something...

title: Ballads of Breeze
description: Lizzie of the Knights of Favonius seems busy with something...

title: Breezy Snapshots
description: Fassben of the Adventurers' Guild seems to be busy with something...

title: A Tour of Wonders
description: Onnea from Mondstadt seems to have something to tell you...

title: Zero Hour Invokation
description: Frida from Mondstadt seems to have something to tell you...

title: Evermotion Mechanical Painting: Invoker
description: Félix Yogue seems to be busy with something in Mondstadt...

title: Heart of the Dice
description: Fein of Mondstadt seems to be troubled by something...

title: Mysterious Fish? A Booming Adventure!
description: After a period of adventures together, Paimon had a sudden idea to take a break by reading books. Hence, the two of you set out to the Knights of Favonius's library, only to unexpectedly come across two friends...

title: Crisis Relieved! A Happy Memento!
description: After having fun playing through Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure, you and Klee hear good news from Lisa, and even receive a surprise gift...

title: Furball Fortress's Frightful Fix!
description: Your recent travels have seen you and Paimon encounter all manner of strange creatures, but in light of various factors, Paimon would still like to have some fun with cats.\nAs such, you intend to return to Mondstadt and drop by The Cat's Tail...

title: Bulle Fruit-Hued Interloper!
description: A certain special guest suddenly arrives at the Furball Fortress a short while into its trial operations, leaving Valerina in a panic...

title: Sir Pouncelot Joins the Lot!
description: Your tireless work as cat saviors has seen your great cat guest grow gentle and well-behaved...\nHowever, its mode of dress indicates that it still has quite the story to tell...

title: Dodoco's Boom-Bastic Escapades!
description: While passing by a quiet garden in Mondstadt, a couple of Knights who are discussing a "new game" draw your and Paimon's attention...

title: Honorary Knight's Notes on Mixology
description: The Knights of Favonius are about to open their drinks stand. Hertha from the Logistics Company is looking for help...

title: A Special Blend, A Timeless Masterpiece
description: After running the drinks stand for a while, your creations have received widespread acclaim and are about to become new classics...

title: Gliding Challenge: New Heights
description: During the special welcome ceremony, Amber and her juniors have prepared a brand-new flying and shooting challenge, waiting for people to come and experience it...

title: A Knight's Guide to Surveying
description: A few knights seem to be exchanging information on surveying techniques...

title: A "Battlefield" Feast After Work

title: Question and Answer
description: Swan does everything by the book — specifically, by the Knights of Favonius Handbook. Previously, Swan wouldn't ask anything of the Traveler, who was not a Knight then. Now that the Traveler is an Honorary Knight, Swan will sometimes quiz the Traveler concerning the contents of the Handbook.

title: Snowy Silhouette: Hope
description: According to Joel, Cyrus has found some leads as to his father's whereabouts...

title: Snowy Silhouette: Reunion
description: The encampment at the Dragonspine foothills has a new guest...

title: Equivalent Exchange
description: Viktor is looking for someone to help him gather some local specialties...

title: Lingering Malady
description: Due to the storm that swept through the city, the posters and signboards of many shops have been blown off to the rooftops and city walls of Mondstadt. Aramis of the Knights of Favonius is currently mulling over how he might retrieve them...

title: Thief-Catcher
description: The storm has just ended, and Cyrus from the Adventurers' Guild is currently planning to clear the Treasure Hoarders out...

title: ...What Do Adventurers Do Again?
description: At Lan's direction, Tiantian of the Adventurers' Guild has been put in charge of distributing commissions, but she has no idea what sort of commissions she should be giving out to adventurers...

title: Will of Stone
description: Millelith soldier Jiayi wants to send a gift to his daughter, Little Liu, but he has no time to return to Qingce Village, and as such is looking for someone to help him out...

title: Solo Venture
description: While investigating the movements of monsters at the Thousand Winds Temple, Jack was discovered due to his recklessness and attacked. Jack somehow made it back to Mondstadt, but he seems to have left something important behind at the Temple...

title: After the Storm
description: After Dvalin was cleansed, access to Stormterror's Lair has been restored. Wagner would like to go there to look for precious Crystal Ore...

title: A Quiet Day in Liyue Harbor
description: Nervous An, busy at the harbor, is looking for someone to help to ease the nerves of guests from other nations...

title: Blackcliff Woes
description: Manager Kuan seems to be troubled by something...

title: Cleanup At Dawn
description: After the storm, head housemaid Adelinde is preparing to render the Dawn Winery spick and span on the inside and out, but things aren't going so smoothly...

title: In the Aftermath
description: Huffman has his hands full with the cleanup work that followed the storm...

title: Treasures of Taishan Fill the Ship
description: Something bad appears to be brewing at Jueyunjian, find its source with the help of the ballad as a clue...

title: Fly a Letter Towards the Sky
description: There's an urban legend circulating in Jueyunjian. If you wish to learn the truth about the adepti, you need to explore and leave no stones unturned.

title: Nine Pillars of Peace
description: Nine stone pillars stand stoic near Cuijue Slope. They seem to hide a certain secret...

title: Luhua Landscape
description: Vermeer, an artist who is looking for inspirational material near Luhua Pool, seems to have hit a snag, and is looking for help...

title: A Little Game
description: You met a strange person on Mt. Tianheng who is looking for someone to play hide-and-seek with him...

title: Trails in Tianqiu
description: There is a strange tablet in Tianqiu Valley that seems to relate some of the valley's history...

title: Time and Wind
description: You reach an uninhabited island across the sea, which is home to an enigmatic sundial. Who knows what secret it holds?

title: The Ocean Pearl
description: A mysterious ship has dropped anchor outside Liyue Harbor. The ship appears to be quite luxurious, all the more reason to hop right on board...

title: A Lone Ship In Guyun
description: A heavily armed ship of unknown origins has stopped outside Guyun Stone Forest. You hop right on board to investigate...

title: Pressing Deadlines
description: Clerk Zhao is so swamped with work that she can't even get a moment to herself. It seems she could use some assistance...

title: No Restoring This Past Land of Beauty
description: Zhiping of the Adventurers' Guild seems to be investigating the earthquakes and strange monster movements in Tianqiu Valley...

title: Verses and Vistas of Lantern Rite (Part II)
description: Painter Vermeer seems to be looking for Qingzhou...

title: Hereafter: The Trail of Pervases
description: When you smell the aroma of Grilled Tiger Fish, you are suddenly reminded of someone who once helped you...

title: Valor's Afterglow
description: Although the incident in The Chasm has come to a close, Zhiqiong is still involved in other exploration work. Best you go check in on her...

title: Chasm Spelunkers
description: Now that you have destroyed the Bedrock Keys, the seal on The Chasm has now come undone. It is time to venture into the depths below.

title: Valor's Afterglow: Return by Sundown
description: Jinwu has an urgent task for you. It seems to involve Zhiqiong...

title: Valor's Afterglow: The Faint Light Remembered
description: Zhiqiong seems to have left the exploration team to explore on her own. Still, it's too dangerous to go alone into The Chasm, so she must be found...

title: First Miasmic Contact
description: Investigate the mysterious environs beneath the stone and take pictures related to the black mud.

title: Meeting New People... and Foiling Some Bandits
description: As you explore the lower levels of The Chasm, you discover Treasure Hoarders. If they think you'll let them do things as they please down here, then they've got another think coming!

title: The Heavenly Stone's Debris
description: To get to ever-deeper levels of The Chasm, you must open the path that was blocked by large stones back when the mine was sealed. Looks like you'll have to borrow the power of the Mountainator this time...

title: Perils in the Dark
description: The strange crystal plummeted toward the ground and shattered it, revealing an entrance to even greater depths. Who knows what's down there... But either way, it would be best to proceed with caution.

title: Surreptitious Seven-Star Seal Sundering
description: You have accepted a commission that requires you to pay The Chasm a visit. Who knows what the situation in the long-sealed mines might be like...

title: Wherefore Did the Spiritstone Descend?
description: Having taken out the Abyss Lectors lurking here, you discover that Zhiqiong has seen the symbols on the key-like object the Lectors left behind somewhere else...

title: The Chasm Charters
description: Lan of the Adventurers' Guild has offered you a commission to explore The Chasm, which you have accepted. First, you'll need to find the representative of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, Muning, who has been stationed there.

title: The Chasm Charters
description: You accept Xu's commission to deliver the Mora Xingqiu has lent out to the Ministry of Civil Affairs' specialist, Muning, at The Chasm.

title: Mycological Investigation in The Chasm
description: The Chasm has a complex ecological and geological system. One of the most curious things here is the glowing mushrooms. Help the Sumeru scholar Khedive to investigate the mushrooms that grow in The Chasm...

title: Hydrological Investigation in The Chasm
description: You fish up something strange in The Chasm. What in the world could it be? According to the Sumeru scholar Khedive, just place it by the water and you will discover its secret...

title: Paleontological Investigation in The Chasm
description: You notice some rocks with peculiar markings on them. It's better to take a few pictures. Perhaps someone might know what these are...

title: Undetected Infiltration
description: The Treasure Hoarders who were behaving oddly turned out to be Millelith in disguise. In response to the resultant situation, their leader asks for your aid in taking out the Treasure Hoarder camps...

title: The Chasm's Bounty
description: A Liyue miner named Qi Ding has somehow gone missing. Seeing as how The Chasm is a perilous place, you decide to help look for him.

title: The Missing Miner
description: Uncle He, a veteran miner at The Chasm, went missing when the mine was previously evacuated. But due to a series of coincidences, you unearth evidence that he may still be alive...

title: Lost in a Foreign Land
description: You run into a less-hostile Fatui mage in The Chasm. What is she doing here?

title: Lost in a Foreign Land: Seeking
description: You run into a Fatui mage named Katarina who is wandering alone in The Chasm. What is she doing here? Ask her what's going on.

title: Dimming Mushroom's Call for Help
description: You hear strange sounds — voices, almost — coming from a giant mushroom in The Chasm. Could it be... a giant talking mushroom?

title: A Company Vanishing Into the Deep
description: You encounter a group of Fatui who have lost contact with their troops on the ground. But they don't seem combat able at all and even ask for your help...

title: A Cliff-Side Hero's Past
description: A Treasure Hoarder at the top of The Chasm claims to be from the Guhua Clan. Is he crazy, or is he just lost? Or is there some other secret that lies behind this situation?

title: The Millennial Mountains
description: According to a local legend at The Chasm, one may be able to obtain the "treasure of the Millelith" by offering six items before a memorial.

title: Stolen, by the Rightful Owner
description: The bard Taliesin seeks your help. As it turns out, the ring that he stole from the Weasel Thieves has been stolen once again by another bunch of Weasel Thieves...

title: Says He Who Seeks Stone
description: Help Muning to complete Huishan Hall's bounty and find Archaic Stone distributed throughout The Chasm's upper levels...

title: Prospecting Thieves (Continued)
description: Prospecting Thieves (Continued)

title: Garcia's Paean
description: You meet two oddballs at Wangshu Inn...

title: On the Stage, Behind the Stage
description: Something seems to be troubling Tea Master Liu Su of Heyu Tea House...

title: An Ancient Sacrifice of Sacred Brocade
description: Help the Adeptus Fujin complete a ritual that will heal the land of Chenyu Vale.

title: The Tales Behind the Fan
description: After returning from The Chasm, you decide to take a walk in the city...

title: Qiaoying of the Sacred Mountain
description: On first arriving at Chenyu Vale, you are asked by the adeptus, Fujin, to help investigate imbalances in the local water and soil...

title: Floating Jade, Treasure of Chenyu
description: Little Mao seems to have some information about how to help heal Chenyu Vale...

title: The Roaming Abode
description: At night, out in the wild, you encounter a little girl standing on a bamboo raft...

title: Threefold Expectations
description: The teapot troubles are still causing Uncle Luo quite the headache...

title: A Wangshan Walk to Remember
description: At Huang the Third's invitation, you arrive at the legendary place where the treasure of the Guhua Clan is located, Wangshan Hall...

description: Uncover the secret left behind by Guhua

title: Shrouded Vale, Hidden Hero
description: Uncover the secret left behind by Guhua

description: Hezhe Post seems to be organizing an interesting event named "Our Chenyu Vale Trek"...

description: Yaodie Valley seems to conceal secrets unknown to all...

description: Two groups of unknown individuals are fighting fiercely in the wilderness. What in the world is going on?

title: The Cloud-Padded Path to the Chiwang Repose

title: Adeptus's Gift

title: Wishing Wonderful Wishes

description: Following Pingxi's suggestion, you decide to release a Celebratory Xiao Lantern... Or would a Gift Xiao Lantern do just fine as well?

title: Spike Self-Circulation Report: Conclusion
description: Now that you have transported the Spike to the deepest section, all that is left to do is to activate it and close the Ley Line rupture.

title: Just Wushou Dance!
description: During the Lantern Rite Festival, you and Paimon run into Gaming and another friend practicing the Wushou Dance together. He has prepared an endlessly fascinating event, and is waiting for guests to come and experience it...

title: Paper Shadow Ruminations
description: On the bustling streets of Liyue Harbor, you and Paimon are drawn to a painter making paper cutouts. You spy two familiar silhouettes among the items she is preparing...

title: Iridescent Cloud-Striding
description: As you pass by a lane in Yilong Wharf, a sincere Storyteller's disciple approaches you and narrates a tale intimately related to you both...

description: You discovered a strange encampment in Lingju Pass. Something seems to have happened here...

description: Ms. Yu, a resource manager from the Ministry of Civil Affairs, has something to say to you...
unlockDescription: Complete this quest to unlock City Reputation for Liyue

title: The Vishaps Lie Dormant, but the Enigma Lingers Still
description: After a sustained effort, you seem to have scared the Geovishaps into submission and the disturbances across the land seem to have subsided. However, the reason for their re-emergence and rampage remains a mystery...

title: Mr. Melancholy
description: Yingzhu of the Adventurers' Guild has been having dealings with a scholar from the Sumeru Akademiya, but things seem to be going downhill, fast...

title: We Meet Again, Mr. Melancholy
description: After some painstaking gathering, it's time to report back to Hosseini.

title: A Teapot to Call Home: Part II
description: The crisis looming over Liyue Harbor has calmed, and it's business as usual in the city. However, Madame Ping, the flower-admirer from Yujing Terrace, seems to have something more to discuss with you...
unlockDescription: Complete this quest to unlock managing your Serenitea Pot Realm

title: Idle Teapot Talk
description: Tubby, the teapot spirit in your Serenitea Pot, seems to have something to say to you...
unlockDescription: Complete this quest to unlock inviting Companions to your Serenitea Pot

title: Floating Spirits — The Investigation Begins
description: Recently, more and more adventurers have encountered a floating elemental being. Inazuma City's Katheryne is releasing a series of commissions to minimize needless risks and lay the groundwork for further investigation.

title: Floating Spirits — The Investigation Ends
description: After a period of investigation, the Adventurers' Guild has eliminated the possible threats that the Specter incident may have caused, and they have also collected a lot of related information. This information has already been handed over to professional researchers, and it seems likely that they will soon make some further progress.

title: Elixirs and Potions
description: Timaeus, the alchemist from Mondstadt, is currently troubled by a certain research topic...

title: Academic Exchange
description: The Smoldersleet Potion's phased trials are over. It is time to report back to Timaeus...

title: Divine Ingenuity
description: Katheryne of the Liyue Harbor Adventurers' Guild seems to be looking for you...

title: A Visitor From Westward Realms
description: A person from Sumeru has arrived at the wharfs of Liyue Harbor. She seems to be in a bit of a fix...

title: Vibro-Crystal Projections
description: A certain researcher from Fontaine is currently performing some esoteric research in The Chasm.

title: Search Chronicle: Burning Up!
description: You receive a very strange commission. Go to the area around the Pyro Regisvine to learn more from the client.

title: Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp!
description: Your diet has been quite plain recently, and Paimon's been missing the spice of life in food...\nAs such, you head over to Wanmin Restaurant, only to meet two old friends...

description: After the Pyro Regisvine, Ranjit's next target is a Primo Geovishap...

title: Our Animal Friends: Epilogue
description: The Claw Convoy animal rescue society's gift-swapping event has ended. Zhenchen is sorting through the gifts that the society has received...

title: Tumult Subduer
description: The Adventurers' Guild has reported strange activity in Liyue's Sal Terrae, and the Millelith have sealed the area off. Sensing danger, you and Paimon decide to head over to investigate...

title: A Defensive Strategy
description: Having successfully ventured into the Ley Line disturbance's hidden Domain and emerged victorious from its trials, it's time to report back to Keqing and Yelan...

title: The Moonlit Adeptus's Trail
description: You run into someone who loves listening to stories in Liyue Harbor...

title: Vigorous Brushstrokes

title: Wishes Contended, Fortunes Won
description: You come across a strange stall in Liyue Harbor...

title: Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl!
description: You and Paimon have been feeling pretty good recently, so you're thinking about taking on some more commissions from the Adventurers' Guild! Little did you expect, however, to run into some Arataki Gang members openly scheming nearby...

title: The Beetle Battles Will Never End!
description: The Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl appears to have been a great success, and it's now time to return to the brawl grounds to check on Arataki Itto and Grandmaster Hanakado...

title: Travelers' Tales: Destiny Drawn
description: Something new seems to be happening at the Grand Narukami Shrine...
unlockDescription: Complete this quest to unlock "Travelers' Tales: Make-A-Wish"

title: The Gourmet Supremos: On the Road
description: Xudong, the self-proclaimed leader of the Gourmet Supremos, seems to have something he'd like some help with...

title: International Travel Log
description: Midori from Inazuma City seems to be troubled by something...

title: Home Lies Over the Ocean
description: Atsuko, who is living in Liyue, seems to have something on her mind...

title: O Archon, Have I Done Right?
description: The shrine that Shouta has been giving sincere offerings to has stopped giving him replies. He seeks you out for help...

title: Battle of Revenge
description: Asukara has discovered the Kairagi's whereabouts. The time has come for a rematch to reclaim his weapon...

title: Yae Publishing House's Invitation
description: Aratani, an editor at the Yae Publishing House, seems to have something she'd like a little help with...

title: Chisato's Letter
description: Chisato, lady of the Hiiragi Clan, which leads the Kanjou Commission, requests that you help her bring a letter to her sweetheart, Kujou Kamaji...

title: Katheryne in Inazuma
description: According to Katheryne in Liyue Harbor, you will be able to find her on Narukami Island as well...
unlockDescription: Complete this quest to unlock commissions for Inazuma

title: The Ritou Road
description: You happen upon a hidden passageway in Ritou...

title: Storytelling Method
description: Junkichi seems to be struggling with his writing again...

title: Fertilizer... Salesperson?
description: Iwata of Watatsumi Island appears to be having some troubles...

title: Vimana Agama: First Chapter
description: You heard from Araja that the Aranara were investigating a suspicious Nara near Devantaka Mountain. You wonder if it has anything to do with the missing kids at Vimara Village...

title: The Children of Vimara Village
description: The woman who goes by the name of Rana seems to be a Forest Watcher of Sumeru. Accept her invitation and travel to Vimara Village.

title: Into the Woods
description: You and Paimon put in a good amount of hard work to sort your stories into a version that the children might find interesting. Thankfully, they like your stories. Although they don't seem to have told the truth about the mysterious creatures, this isn't the time to go into detail. Now, go with Rana to clear out some Withering Zones. You're doing this so the children of Vimara Village can play safely, after all.

title: The Lost Child
description: You have taken care of the Withering Zones marked by Rana as well as the Spinocrocodiles. The children at Vimara Village should be safe now. Head back with Rana.

title: A Delicacy for Nara
description: According to Arapacati, the rising pillars of smoke will lead to her brothers who are doing "cooking training." We need to find them and bring them back before the festival starts...

title: Varuna Gatha
description: A few Aranara in Apam Woods could use some help...

title: Memory of Stone
description: Aranakula, who is said to be rather timid, has gone to the Yasna Monument, which is flooded with dangerous Fungi. Aranakula has seldom been left alone without the company of soil and seeds, so the poor little thing must need help now...

title: Irate Iron Chunk
description: Inarticulate Arabalika is exploring the Ruins of Dahri, where "Big Iron Chunks" abound, alone. Though he is a master of Ararakalari, it may be better to check in on him...

title: Slumbering Roots
description: Arakunti has headed to the Grove of Dreams, where a way to enter dreams is said to reside. However, the twisting roots of the great tree make finding Aranara — or anything else there really — a taxing task and then some...

title: A Prayer for Rain on the Fecund Land
description: The "branches and leaves" of the Varuna Contraption that were scattered in Vana were all healed. In Arapandu's words, it's time to get rid of the bad bugs gnawing on the roots of the Varuna Contraption...

title: Cooking, a Pleasant Memory
description: According to Arachatora, his brother Arasaka is doing "cooking training" near Gandharva Ville. Look for a pillar of smoke near Gandharva Ville!

title: Cooking, the Flavor of Nature
description: You received a commission from Arapacati in Vanarana to help look for her brothers who are practicing cooking. Do as Arapacati says and look for the rising pillars of smoke.

title: Cooking, the Aroma of Homecoming
description: According to Arachatora, his brother Arapas is doing "cooking training" close to Apam Woods. Look for a pillar of smoke near Apam Woods!

title: Cooking, the Beauty of Sharing
description: According to Arachatora, his brother Araphala is doing "cooking training" close by Devantaka Mountain. Look for a pillar of smoke near Devantaka Mountain!

title: A Short Encounter with a Rare Bird
description: You bumped into a Forest Ranger, Shefket, who's carrying out ecological research in Sumeru's forests, and he told you about his Dusk Bird research. Can he really capture a Dusk Bird?

title: Woodland Encounter
description: Someone is being attacked by Fungi in the woods. You hurry to help them.

title: The World of Aranara
description: Finally, you meet the mysterious Aranara again. According to Arana, you need to visit Vanarana and find Bija to help Rana. Moreover, you have to play the Rhythm of the Great Dream before getting to the world of Aranara. Head back to Vimara Village, and ask Amadhiah if he has any instrument that you can borrow.

title: Vimana Agama: Jazari's Chapter
description: You were finally able to get inside the Ruin Golem. If it can be activated, gaining access to the underground ruins should be a simple matter...

title: Vimana Agama: Dev Delver Chapter
description: Somehow, you managed to open the entrance to the underground ruins. Once you find the core in the Dev's Cavern, the truth about the forest's "disease" will be unveiled...

title: Royinjan's Chapter: Linga
description: You've located the fragments with the help of Amadhiah and Royinjan. One of them lies in a submerged cavern...

title: Royinjan's Chapter: Yoni
description: You have located the fragments with the help of Amadhiah and Royinjan. One of them lies in a cavern deep within Devantaka Mountain...

title: For A Better Reunion
description: After all the adventures with the Aranara in the forest, we are getting closer to Bija... Right? Anyway, let's check on Rana first.

title: Festival Utsava
description: You returned to Vanarana with Arama after parting with Arana and Rana. It's finally time for Festival Utsava.

title: Children of the Forest
description: To acquire Bija and help Rana, you have to find and help Aranara, and prepare for Festival Utsava. As for the Aranyaka from Arama, it could be used to document the stories about Aranara, and clues for the adventure.

title: For Fruits, Seeds, and Trees
description: When you wake up, Festival Utsava is no more, and Arama is nowhere to be found. Only the faint fragrance from the garland tells you that this was not a dream.

title: For the Children of the Past
description: The Ashvattha Tree has been corroded. But from its fruit, Arama seems to have gained new knowledge, memories, and... manners of speech. According to Arama, you should eliminate Marana's Avatar next so that the new Ashvattha Tree may be born. Only then can the Bija be formed.

title: For All Children Who Long for Life
description: Now, only the final enemy awaits vanquishing. Continue forward. Never, ever, stop moving forward.

title: "Hello," "Thank You," and the Final "Goodbye"
description: Finally, you claimed the Bija. It's time to return to Rana.

title: Taste of Happiness
description: Time to witness the results of the "cooking training" of Arapacati's brothers.

title: Delicious Riddle
description: The resourceful Araesha has prepared "delicious" riddles for Festival Utsava.

title: Garden Fairies
description: At Festival Utsava, Aralila and Aranishat seem to be fighting over something...

title: Rishboland Tiger, Roaaar
description: Seems that Arakanta wants to play Rishboland Tiger and Aranara.

title: Rescue the Aranara
description: Rescue the Aranara surrounded by monsters

title: Look for and rescue the Aranara
description: Look for and rescue the Aranara surrounded by monsters

title: The Foolish Fatuus
description: There are several strange camps in the Sumeru forest, and each camp has a strange machine installed within. The Fatui seem to be using these machines to do something weird. It's best to investigate this matter...

title: Lost in the Sands
description: In Aaru Village, there is a merchant from Mondstadt who needs help from adventurers.

title: An Introduction to Indoor Archaeology
description: You have left the pit with the archaeological team. Now it is time to head over to the oasis Jebrael mentioned and get ready to camp there.

title: The Secret of Al-Ahmar
description: Tirzad accidentally opened the hidden passage behind the mural. No one knows where it may lead...

title: Dreams Beneath the Searing Sand
description: The merchants and their Sumpter Beasts waiting in the oasis might be in danger. Hurry back to the camp in the oasis to secure Nachtigal's safety.

title: Aranaga's Memory
description: You meet an old man named Khayyam in the forest. He seems to share a past with Aranara. It should do no harm to respond to his request for help...

title: Aranakin's Old Friend
description: After that last adventure, Aranakin really forgot a lot of things. No matter what, how could the new and old friends he made be forgotten so easily?

title: Aragaru's Drawing
description: You helped Aragaru defeat the Eremites in Chatrakam Cave. Their goal, however, seems to be related to a friendship that Aragaru has forgotten...

title: Memory's Final Chapter
description: Though lost memories flow by like water, friendships may be reborn with time...

title: Until Vana is Healed
description: You wonder how Ararycan is doing. Go find him when you have the time.

title: Courage Is in the Heart
description: You found a journal by the Aranara named Arashakun in an Aranara house. Despite losing "courage," Arashakun still decided to venture into such a dangerous place. Go check the situation out...

title: The Rhythm that Leads to the Gloomy Path
The Rhythm that Nurtures the Sprout
Giving Flowers
description: There are so many Sweet Flowers in Vanarana's garden now. Varsha would be ecstatic to see it for herself for sure.

title: Vimana Agama: Royinjan's Chapter
description: To find the Amiti Device to open the Ruin Golem, you decided to follow Royinjan to a secret base in Vimara Village.

title: The Rhythm that Reveals the Beastly Trail
Legends of the Stone Lock
description: After unlocking the stone lock in Sumeru, and defeating the monsters trapped in the seal, you will be entrusted by Aranara to defeat other sealed monsters.

title: Encounter in the Woods
description: Talk to Arakavi in Vanarana, which might help the groundwork for Festival Utsava.

title: Dual Evidence
description: While in Aaru Village, you meet another Vahumana researcher named Kalantari. He has been fretting over his paper lately and is seeking help...

title: Afratu's Dilemma
description: Somewhere in the desert in front of a giant ruin machine, Mahamata Afratu seems to be troubled by something...

title: Static Views
description: Paimon found a painting in Vanarana that could be a treasure map...

title: Static Views, Part 2
description: As more treasure was found through the "mailbox," the "seed" collected long ago in The Chasm begins to vibrate...

title: Dune-Entombed Fecundity: Part III
description: This is the final part of the journey to the Eternal Oasis. With any luck, this will prove a smooth trip...

title: Cost-Effective Hook
description: Kayvan the angler seems to be having some trouble...

title: The Path of Papers
description: You see an anxious person near the Akademiya...\n

title: For a Dream I Tarry
description: You meet a strange person outside the forest.

title: Soheil's Wish
description: Soheil's archaeological notes record his desert adventures in his youth. Some of the ruins mentioned may contain treasures and old records. Head into the depths of the desert again to look for them.

title: Even Beasts Stumble
description: You find someone in danger in the outskirts of Sumeru...

title: Dune-Entombed Fecundity: Part I
description: With the help of the Tanit, you prepare to enter Mt. Damavand in search of the secrets that lie buried within the Eternal Oasis...

title: Dune-Entombed Fecundity: Part II
description: You run into Azariq in the desert and find yourself invited to accept his help in making your way to the next location...

title: Invisible Barrier
description: Soheil's archaeological notes record his desert adventures in his youth. Some of the ruins mentioned may contain treasures and old records. Head into the depths of the desert again to look for them.

title: Desert's Remembrance
description: Soheil's archaeological notes record his desert adventures in his youth. Some of the ruins mentioned may contain treasures and old records. Head into the depths of the desert again to look for them.

title: The Exile: Sprouting
description: The Sumeru Roses planted by Sabbah never grow. Try to help her.

title: The Exile: Blooming
description: A rose that once bloomed in Sumeru City may be able to bloom elsewhere, too.

title: A Gifted Rose: Prickly as Thorns
description: The old man who lives alone on the outskirts of the village may be the flower grower mentioned by Sabbah. Help him clean up his nursery.

title: A Gifted Rose: Long Day Ahead
description: The flowers planted by Affan haven't sprouted yet. Water them for him.

title: A Gifted Rose: Can Stones Bloom
description: Affan's flowers still haven't sprouted. Try to help the disappointed fellow.

title: A Gifted Rose: Ballad of Days Gone By
description: Follow Sabbah's advice and try to "Awaken" the seeds

title: A Gifted Rose: Some People Never Fade Away
description: Join others to witness the Golden Rose in full bloom.

title: Behold, the Sign Comes Like A Thief...
description: Yuften's goods appear to have been stolen by some unknown party. They need to be recovered.

title: The Temple Where Sand Flows Like Tears
description: To help Jeht find the Eternal Oasis, you must first find a Jinni who knows about the ancient past. It is said that this ruined temple plays host to just such a being...

title: The Eternal Dream, Ever Lush
description: Finally, you have arrived at the unchanging, eternal oasis, and thus is a great weight lifted off Jeht's shoulders...

title: For Her Judgment Reaches to the Skies...
description: Sometimes, the best way to deal with schemes is by brutal force — a knot that cannot be undone can be ripped apart.

title: Trees and Dreams
description: You feel the calling of some mysterious presence after talking to Araja.

title: Asipattravana Itihasa
description: You need the help of the Pari Mihir and Rashnu to obtain the Chaplet. You might be able to find Mihir's trail in Asipattravana Swamp...

title: The Hymn of Tir Yazad
description: Access the Harvisptokhm through the path of the depths, and complete the final Rite of Ab-Zohr.

title: Blooming Sands
description: Raef from Aaru Village seems to be troubled by something...

title: Awakening's Real Sound
description: You need the help of the Pari Mihir and Rashnu to obtain the Chaplet. Rashnu seems to be around the giant tree at the Hills of Barsom...

title: The Splendorous Sky That Day
description: To solve the anomaly that has appeared in the sky, you must first go into the desert to make contact with the "Nagarjunites"...

title: Sprouting Seedlings
description: The Varuna Contraption has been fixed, and now Aranakula can go back to take care of the nursery that he has been thinking about. Aranakula, who likes to keep company with soil and seeds, not only cultivates ordinary plants, but also takes care of a special nursery in Vanarana.

title: Rejoice With Me, for What Was Lost Is Now Found
description: Though Jeht made quick work of Aderfi, who had been a traitor to the Tanit tribe, you can't help but wonder how Benben's doing after being entrusted to him...

title: An Unwavering Culinary Dream
description: Something is bothering Arapacati lately...

title: Encounter in the Woods
description: Talk to Arakavi in Vanarana, which might help the groundwork for Festival Utsava.

title: As the Khvarena's Light Shows
description: Go to Zurvan to obtain the Twin-Horned Chaplet, and you will be able to go around collecting the Great Songs of Khvarena...

title: As the Khvarena's Light Shows: Samudaya
description: With Nasejuna's aid, you now know where the Great Songs might be found. One of them is hidden in the catacombs containing a Korybantes...

title: As the Khvarena's Light Shows: Dukkha
description: With Nasejuna's aid, you now know where the Great Songs might be found. One of them is hidden in a cave where the Wenut sleeps...

title: As the Khvarena's Light Shows: Nirodha
description: With Nasejuna's aid, you now know where the Great Songs might be found. One of them is hidden within a Khaenri'ahn underground ruin...

title: The Hymn of Tir Yazad
description: You've managed to gather all the Great Songs of Khvarena regardless. Now, it is time to resolve the anomaly in the sky...

title: Make Bright the Arrows, Gather the Shields...
description: Jeht has not yet returned to the tribe, and now you can only count on the results of Babel's investigation...

title: Join the Eremites and Embrace a Wonderful New Life!
description: In Aaru Village, it seems that a member of the Eremites is recruiting...

title: Tadhla the Falcon
description: Tadhla, Masseira's "Falcon," has been on a mission for a long time and has not returned. Thus Masseira asks you to find his "Falcon"...

title: "The Falcon's Hunt"
description: After the previous adventure, it seems that Masseira still has some favor to ask of you...

title: The Fallen Falcon
description: Masseira tells you that Tadhla is waiting for you in the place where you first met. Sounds like Tadhla has something urgent to talk to you about...

title: Monumental Study
description: Sosi's research doesn't seem to be going well...

title: Wisdom Has Built Her House, She Has Hewn Out Her Seven Pillars
description: Katheryne of the Sumeru Adventurers' Guild seems to be looking for you...

title: An Artist Adrift
description: You find an artist from Fontaine in distress in a cave by the water...

title: An Artist Adrift
description: You find an artist from Fontaine in distress in a cave by the water...

title: An Artist Adrift
description: The famous artist from Fontaine, Julien, remains in Sumeru...

title: Memories of Gurabad
description: There was a strange vibration in the ancient "training field" which, according to Liloupar, may have something to do with Gurabad's long past...

title: Pale Fire
description: A magical Plume of Purifying Light has formed on the Fravashi Tree. One wonders what secrets it holds within...

title: Awaken the Residual Pari in the Fravashi Trees
description: The residual Pari residing within the Fravashi Trees are still trapped in obsessions of the past. It seems that Sorush can awaken them...

title: Awaken the Residual Pari in the Fravashi Trees
description: The residual Pari residing within the Fravashi Trees are still trapped in obsessions of the past. It seems that Sorush can awaken them...
