description: The residual Pari residing within the Fravashi Trees are still trapped in obsessions of the past. It seems that Sorush can awaken them...

title: Lightcall Resonance
description: In the Tunigi Hollow, you, Paimon, and Sorush encounter an eccentric Pari. She seems to be preparing for some sort of trial...

title: Search for the Lost Monument Fragments
description: The note Sosi gave you marks the potential locations of the monument fragments. Because mere mortals often fail to discern its shape, you might need Sorush's help retrieving the fragments...

title: Investigate the Fatui Camps Marked by Sosi
description: According to Sosi, some uninvited guests seem to be coveting the divine powers of the monument. You might have to defeat their officer in order to drive them away...

title: Awaken the Residual Pari in the Fravashi Trees
description: The residual Pari residing within the Fravashi Trees are still trapped in obsessions of the past. It seems that Sorush can awaken them...

title: Awaken the Residual Pari in the Fravashi Trees
description: The residual Pari residing within the Fravashi Trees are still trapped in obsessions of the past. It seems that Sorush can awaken them...

title: Heart of Amrita
description: Farther inside the Vourukasha Oasis, a mysterious Pari is waiting for you...

title: Purbiruni's Commandment
description: According to Khedive, anyone carrying his handwritten "letter of recommendation" is guaranteed help from Purbiruni.

title: Recollections of a Fontainian
description: You encounter an anxious man from Fontaine in Sumeru City...

title: Rocking Carriage
description: Masud, known as the Phantom Toy Master, is at the Sabzeruz Festival recommending his new game to guests...

title: Mapping Dreams and Reality
description: A certain Amurta researcher is looking for volunteers for her psychotherapy experiment...

title: Shadow of the Knight's Blade
description: Vihar and the researcher Safi are currently preparing for a special event that will tell the tale of "The Unknown Battles of the Knight of Flowers"...

title: Reunite, My Shroom Buddies!
description: You and Paimon run into some old friends and incredible companions at Bayda Harbor...

title: A Meeting of "Puppets"
description: Go to Lambad's Tavern, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Hat Guy...

title: Tea Party Re-Invitation: Hat Guy
description: Go to Lambad's Tavern, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Hat Guy...

title: The Unappreciated Carving
description: For reasons unknown, two craftsmen are sighing over a unique carving in the open market of Port Ormos...

title: Selling Like Hot Carvings
description: Did the kids like new carving? Did Tanger repent? Go to Port Ormos and find out.

title: Treasure of Wisdom: A New Plan
description: Drusus, a researcher who loves riddles, seems to have a new idea recently...

title: A Librarian's Long and Carefree Vacation
description: Effendi, the Akademiya's Liaison Officer, is looking for suitable volunteers for a long-term research project under the Spantamad Darshan...

title: Old Friends, New Game
description: You and Paimon meet two old friends at Port Ormos. They seem to be preparing for a game of some sort...

title: Parting Arrangement
description: Fungus Mechanicus's testing phase is coming to a close. It's time to give Haniyyah and Balfour some feedback...

title: Boiling Over!
description: You and Paimon meet a certain strange student by the Wall of Samiel to the southwest of the rainforest. She seems to have reason to remember the two of you...

title: An Abundant Estimation
description: The testing on the Shock-Boiled Brews is progressing smoothly. It is time to report back to Hajanad...

title: The Culling of the Worms: Proposal
description: Near Aaru Village, you encounter an anxious-looking researcher...

title: The Culling of the Worms: Gathering
description: After running about, you manage to help Vinayak gather the components...

title: The Culling of the Worms: Introduction
description: Near the meeting spot with the two researchers, you hear a quarrel in the distance...

title: The Culling of the Worms: Testing
description: You were unexpectedly attacked by a Wenut...

title: The Culling of the Worms: Body
description: After three days of busywork, the Wenutslayer Cannon will finally showcase its power...

title: The Culling of the Worms: Demonstration
description: With a roar from the Wenutslayer Cannon, the Wenut falls to the ground...

title: The Culling of the Worms: Conclusion
description: Near the meeting spot with the two scholars, you once again hear the sound of a distant quarrel...

title: The Culling of the Worms: Presentation
description: Based on Shriya's reasoning, you have successfully found where the root of the problem is...

title: The Culling of the Worms: Ending
description: In the desert, you once again see a familiar figure in the distance, but you don't hear the familiar arguing this time...

title: "That Incident From Twenty Years Ago"
description: Dori says that she has the latest update on the Akademiya Extravaganza. Why not go and hear it?

title: Sachin's Article
description: There seems to be something else behind what Dori has told you. Why not go and ask her for more information?

title: The Contestant
description: You meet Dori again. Ask her if she knows something else...

title: When the Curtains Close
description: Kaveh mentioned that he would be going to the Akademiya for some alone time. Perhaps you should go talk to him.

title: Complex Cartography
description: A visibly troubled adventurer from Liyue stands by the riverside in Sumeru. Is some kind of problem giving them grief...

title: The Phantom Toy Master and the Barking Fox
description: While taking a stroll through Veluriyam Mirage, you and Paimon notice a weary merchant. Perhaps giving her a hand may earn you a rare reward...

title: Crocs? Water Cannons? It's War!
description: After stumbling into a "dangerous area," you and Paimon run into a special engineer who's tinkering with a promising contraption...

title: Aren't Finches the Cutest?
description: Somewhere in the Veluriyam Mirage, you and Paimon run into a cheerful researcher who invites you to play a game...

title: Determined and Elegant Battle Dance?
description: In the main area of the Pavilion of Hermits, a strange "Blade Dancer" seems to have sensed something important from you...

title: Fight for Academic Reputation!
description: You meet a familiar-looking researcher sighing by the side of the road. Go ask him what's wrong.

title: Report the Experimental Data
description: The experiment is complete! Report the data on the long-lasting Fayz Potion to Jami.

title: An Odd Textual Mystery
description: Collei tells you that Sumeru's been quite lively lately. As such, you and Paimon resolve to see what's going on...

title: Thesis Proposal: He Shall not Pass
description: Strange rumors are spreading in Port Ormos about a "groaning Akademiya researcher." You wonder what happened...

title: The Cliffside Weirdo and a Risky Study?
description: You hear that a strange person is wandering in the mountain to the east of Sumeru City...

title: Controllable Explosion
description: The testing on the "Remelting Tablets" is progressing smoothly. It is time to report back to Hajanad...

title: Amir's Raw Meat Commission
description: Amir from Gandharva Ville needs eight servings of Raw Meat.

title: Peseng's Zaytun Peaches
description: Peseng from Port Ormos needs ten Zaytun Peaches.

title: Kamla's Berries
description: Kamla from Port Ormos needs fifteen Berries.

title: Housein's Harra Fruits
description: Housein from Sumeru City needs ten Harra Fruits.

title: Dwarkanath's White Iron Chunks
description: Dwarkanath from Sumeru City needs five White Iron Chunks.

title: Kourosh's Sumeru Roses
description: Kourosh from the Grand Bazaar needs ten Sumeru Roses.

title: Yavanani's Apples
description: Yavanani from Sumeru City needs five Apples.

title: Arina's Nilotpala Lotuses
description: Arina from Sumeru City needs five Nilotpala Lotuses.

title: Jahan's Sugar
description: Jahan from Sumeru City needs five jars of Sugar.

title: Arayesh's Jam
description: Arayesh from Port Ormos needs two jars of Jam.

description: The reckless Eremites are raging...

description: The Fatui are rampant...

description: The reckless Eremites are raging...

description: Fungi are raging...

description: The hilichurls are causing trouble...

description: Ruin Drakes are raging...

description: Ruin Drakes are raging...

title: Corps of Thirty Recruitment
description: The Corps of Thirty is hiring an assistant. Interested candidates, kindly contact Effendi at the Citadel of Regzar.
unlockDescription: Complete this quest to unlock City Reputation for Sumeru

title: Treasures Beneath the Vines
description: You run into a strange person near Sumeru City...

title: Where the Future Stars Fall

description: Go to Silvermoon Hall, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Columbina...

description: Go to the hidden dwelling, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Columbina...

title: Animal Research: Chic Badgers
description: There have been rumored sightings of a purple Chic Badger around Thunderclap Reef...

title: Animal Research: Golden Loaches
description: Golden Loaches appear to inhabit Voidsea Outlook as well...

title: Animal Research: Capybaras
description: According to intel from The Flagship, a group of smugglers has been poaching rare-colored Capybaras in Natlan...

title: Animal Research: Frostfin Whales
description: It is said that a pink Frostfin Whale has been spotted in the waters northwest of Lempo Isle...

title: Special Research: Melusine?
description: An extraordinary Melusine was spotted traveling with a mechanical dog...

title: Mineral Research: Rainbowdrop Crystals
description: Rainbowdrop Crystals have been discovered at the eastern tip of Hiisi Island...

title: Mineral Research: Pine Amber
description: An ore-rich site has been discovered at Dreadshade Mire...

title: Mineral Research: Moonfall Silver
description: There appears to be some kind of event taking place in the plaza of Nasha Town...

title: Mineral Research: Icy Pebbles
description: A large number of Icy Pebbles are scattered along the western coast of Hiisi Island...

title: Plant Research: Winter Icelea
description: Winter Icelea has been spotted west of Piramida...

title: Plant Research: Frostlamp Flowers
description: Clusters of Frostlamp Flowers have been found west of Frostmoon Enclave...

title: Plant Research: Twinleaf Pitcher Plants
description: A large patch of Twinleaf Pitcher Plants has suddenly appeared somewhere on Lempo Isle...

title: Plant Research: Nocturnal Blossoms
description: Nocturnal Blossoms are also growing north of Nasha Town, in areas where kuuvahki levels are lower...

title: The Joyous Floating Island
description: One day, a mysterious voice invites you to visit her witch's lodge...

title: The Silent Theater
description: A new room has opened...

description: At Luyang Academy, you encounter a Guhua sword practitioner honing their skills...

description: You receive a tea party invitation letter from Sandrone...\nNote: <color=#FFE14BFF>It is recommended that you complete</color> "Sunny Summer Fontinalia" for the best experience.

title: A Gift of Memories
description: In Nod-Krai, Paimon purchases a special gift for you at the market...

title: A Warm Promise
description: Before you even realize, you've filled up the entire photo album. Think back on all these special moments together with Paimon.

title: Dance Exchanges — A Beautiful Start
description: You encounter a group of unusual visitors from Sumeru at the People of the Springs...

title: Moonlit Patrol Exercise
description: On the outskirts of Paha Isle, a fierce wargame simulation seems to be unfolding...

title: End of a Leisurely Holiday
description: After days of intense "sparing," the moment of parting quietly arrives...

title: Technical Martial Challenge
description: In Nod-Krai, a unique martial arts tournament has now reached its most thrilling moment...

title: Final Match Concludes, Champion Decided
description: The martial arts challenge has come to an end. It is time to decide on the champion...

title: Blessings of the Frost Moon
description: You encounter Lauma, who is deep in thought, at the Frostmoon Enclave...

title: To the Lighthouse
description: Your explorative footsteps echo on the island. There is no one around, and the sole lighthouse remains silent in the darkness...

title: Problem-Sorting Robot
description: In the Krumkake Craftshop, Aino is currently having trouble with a malfunctioning robot...

title: Misplaced Creativity
description: Fontainian researcher Ginette has designed a certain type of robot, but has asked Aino for help due to running into various malfunctions...

title: Blessings of the Frost Moon
description: You encounter Lauma, who is deep in thought at the completed Grand Library...

title: The Sun Rises Once More
description: The sun will always pierce the darkness and shine hope down...

title: New Idea
description: Ginette tweaks the recovered robots, and a new possibility blooms for her research...

title: A Whole New Craftshop
description: Thanks to your tireless efforts in collecting materials, the Krumkake Craftshop's workbench has a spanking new groove...

title: The Last Step of Testing
description: Ginette's idea seems to work, but she's just one step away...

title: Unwritten Rules
description: You and Paimon both hope to see Ginette's research bear fruit. However, the actors in this play turn out to be much more than they seem...

title: Venture Towards the Moonlight
description: You once again encounter a familiar face at the Adventurers' Guild in Nod-Krai...
unlockDescription: Complete this quest to unlock commissions for Nod-Krai

title: Food Matters
description: Lyylikki, who is in charge of food distribution, seems to be in some trouble...

title: The Moonlit Watcher
description: The Lightkeepers stationed at Cliffwatch Camp seem to have run into some trouble...

title: The Moonlit Watcher
description: Once the camp is set up, Illuga should be able to rest for a while...

title: Witch's Lodge
description: While taking a walk through Nod-Krai, you stumble into a mysterious place...

title: Witch's Chatter
description: After completing the mage's lodge, the sounds of laughter and cheer can be heard coming from within...

title: On This Intoxicating Night
description: The Knights of Favonius's expeditionary force seems to be anticipating something...

title: We'll Dance Together Again!
description: The dance exchange has been incredibly fruitful for both the Natlan and Sumeru dancers...

title: Like Seeds on the Wind
description: Just as people hoped, this post is still thriving, like seeds on the wind...

title: Everlasting as the Moon
description: Spend some time with Columbina in the Silvermoon Hall...

title: Stronghold Guard: Hoard Guard Unit!
description: In Nod-Krai, you encounter a messenger named Blue Bolt, who seems to be testing a certain mechanical defense unit...

title: Origin of the Sequence
description: You discover a strangely familiar tower...

description: (test)Hidden$HIDDEN

title: Sightlines and Camera Tricks
description: A special training ground has been set up in the southern section of Lumidouce Harbor in Fontaine...

title: Flower, Feathers, and Bullets
description: As the Ballistic Deduction drill nears its end, Chevreuse and Chasca seem to have reached some sort of consensus...

title: To Gaze Upon the Dreaming Pale Crown
description: According to the directions from the Eye of Graeae, one of the fragments of his power is located behind Zapolyarny Palace, where the Tsar's White Birch grows...

title: The Stone Beasts, Like Ghouls Seated
description: Find a way to track down the fragment of the Eye of Graeae's power inside the mausoleum that was once the Belyi Tsar's itinerant court...

title: Forbidding Doors of Melancholy
description: You've taken the elevator up. Now, the assembly hall is right in front of you...

title: Down in the Dumps
description: You fall into a mysterious sewer. Now, you have to find a way to get back up as quickly as possible...

title: Through the Gates of Ivory
description: A lone lamp shines in the snowstorm...

title: The Sun's Gilded Apple
description: To recover all of Goggles' power, you and Paimon will have to collect the various fragments scattered all over...

title: Bell Ringing at Dusk
description: The ritual is not yet complete. Better stop Pavlina before that happens...

title: Back on One's Feet
description: You've made it out of the sewer. Now, go look for Nastya at the "town entrance" she told you about earlier.

title: To Rest in a Forgotten Field
description: Follow Nastya "home"...

title: Chorus of Solace
description: You have defeated Zala. Go look for Nastya now...

title: Transplanted From "Yesterday" to "Tomorrow"
description: The "home" Nastya keeps speaking of is right inside that assembly hall looming in the distance...

title: Small Jack Frost, Big Problems
description: While exploring Snezhnaya, you stumble upon a strange settlement of Jack Frosts. They seem to be in the midst of some terrible trouble...

title: Procrustes' Iron Bed
description: The so-called wedding at the House of Hesperides turns out to be less delightful than expected. Pavlina tries to sacrifice Ikor for her wish, though she is fortunately thwarted by Aksinya in the end. Pavlina is also thrown into the Shadow Realm, where she will continue to face off with Aksinya...

title: A Great Heart Fettered by Slender Chains
description: Deep amidst the permafrost's howling blizzards, a towering silhouette suddenly catches your eye... Why is it bound to these icy plains by chains forged from pure snow and ice?

title: Like a Labyrinth Imprisons Her Servants
description: The giant once bound by chains upon the tundra has appeared by the sea... Where is he headed first?

title: House of the Soulless
description: To recover all of Goggles' power, you and Paimon will have to collect the various fragments scattered all over...

title: The Soft Song She Sang
description: The giant of ice and snow seems to want to light up the lighthouse appearing in the Shadow Realm with the flame in his breast. It seems that you'll have to melt the snow around the lighthouse first...

title: Burn the Storehouses and the Stables
description: While on the road, you witness members of a Snezhnayan gang oppressing members of its citizenry. You step in and resolve the problem, but a far more complex situation lies behind this seemingly tiny conflict.

title: Disputes Without Honor and Humanity
description: The Izmaylovs are indeed trying to find a way to open the Shadow Realm under the leadership of its boss, the Little Sire. To gather more information, we must rescue Gureva from their base, an undercover operative who has lost contact...

title: Forested Snowfield
description: While passing a lumberyard south of Morepesok, you unexpectedly ran into some Volkodlaks harassing the local workers... Looks like it's trouble stirred up by gang members again? Seems like it's time for you to step in.

title: An Ark That Used to Be a Soul
description: You must obtain the power that was separated from the Eye of Graeae so that the Eye can return and regain its body...

title: Just Like a Snowball
description: Help the children produce a snowball of the perfect size

title: The Shooting Range and the Deep Shadow Realm
description: After a battle in the Shadow Realm, the Eye of Graeae informs you that a new function has been unlocked for the shooting range accessible via the train.
unlockDescription: Complete this quest to unlock "Edge of Survival"

title: For an Ice Mirror Fragment
description: You find notes left behind by someone who was lost in the snowy mountains... Is he still alive? Is there still time for you to save his life...?

title: Ever Beneath the Waves
description: A strange block of ice floats upon the water. A mysterious voice comes to you over a pipe system, claiming that there is a wooden cabin hanging upside down beneath the ice. Clear the brash ice nearby, and you might cause the cabin to show its true form...

title: The Sunken Ship Sailed Past, Ringing No Bells
description: A wooden cabin has come to a stop above the water. This rather familiar house may currently play host to a certain old acquaintance. Is he in trouble again? Head over to ascertain the situation...

title: In the Tranquility of Cycles
description: The cabin on the ice seems but a hair's breadth from sinking into the sea. What happened while you were gone? Is the owner of the house, who refused to get ashore, still in there? Approach the cabin to check it out.

title: Simple Chores
description: The engineering supervisor, Sobolev, seems to need help...

title: Adventurers of Teyvat: Grand Showdown!
description: While heading to the Snezhnaya Adventurers' Guild headquarters, you and Paimon are stopped in your tracks by two "S-Rank" adventurers...

title: The Way of Mutual Aid and Advancement?
description: Having finally made it to Snezhnaya, you and Paimon decide to stop by Morepesok when you have the chance...

title: An Agreement to Share Tips...
description: After a period of relaxed cooperation with the children of the "Mutual Aid Advancement Network," the exploration plan has essentially been completed, and Chichikova seems to have gained some new insights...

title: Paimon's "Driyosh Problem-Solving Method"
description: The first Adventurers' Tournament has concluded, with you and Paimon emerging as the winners. In addition to rewards from the Snezhnaya Headquarters, you'll also be faced with a series of special questions...

title: Shadows Loom: Part I
description: According to Yarovaya, the Shadow Realm may be the most unstable type of "disaster." The dangers lurking within must therefore be dealt with as swiftly as possible...

title: Shadows Loom: Part II
description: According to Yarovaya, the Shadow Realm may be the most unstable type of "disaster." The dangers lurking within must therefore be dealt with as swiftly as possible...

title: Shadows Loom: Part III
description: According to Yarovaya, the Shadow Realm may be the most unstable type of "disaster." The dangers lurking within must therefore be dealt with as swiftly as possible...

title: Shadows Loom: Part IV
description: According to Yarovaya, the Shadow Realm may be the most unstable type of "disaster." The dangers lurking within must therefore be dealt with as swiftly as possible...

title: Shadows Loom: Part V
description: According to Yarovaya, the Shadow Realm may be the most unstable type of "disaster." The dangers lurking within must therefore be dealt with as swiftly as possible...

title: A Grueling Combat Simulation
description: Talalikhin, an adventurer devoted to researching dangerous phenomena, is conducting some form of simulation training near the Adventurers' Guild headquarters...

title: They Who Hear the Sea
description: You discover a strange conch shell on Twinning Isle in the Golden Apple Archipelago. The sounds that come from within seem to hint at something...

title: The Winding Homeward Way
description: You meet a strange Seelie on Minacious Isle...

title: Who Wields the Wild Wind?
description: No one knows why, but this island seems to be forever affected by strange weather conditions...

title: From Outer Lands
description: You discover a strange wrecked ship on a nameless island. But the question is, where did this ship come from?

title: The Other Side of Isle and Sea
description: You discover a strange mural in the Golden Apple Archipelago...

title: A Trip Through Fog and Wind
description: You discover a strange mural in the Golden Apple Archipelago...

title: Big Badaboom Battle
description: Paimon is very curious about Albedo...

title: Summer Gift
description: A mysterious, joyous gift lies somewhere, waiting to be discovered...

title: Thus Was the Work Done in Vain
description: By chance, you discover notes left by an adventurer who was left stranded by Minacious Isle's traps. However, all that seems to have happened well in the now-unchangeable past. Might there be some way to help him, even if only in a Mirage?

title: Where the Treasure Dwells
description: It seems that pirates have hidden treasure in the Golden Apple Archipelago and divided the clues up into four parts. Recover all the clues and find that treasure!

title: Treasure Voyage
description: Miitoboru, a waverider who claims to be a mighty pirate ship, seems to have something to discuss with you...

title: The Misplaced Photo
description: You meet a Fatui Mirror Maiden on Broken Isle who keeps going on about losing a photo. It seems that you won't be able to communicate with her normally... But if you find some way to bring her back to her senses, perhaps you might be able to figure out why she is here.

title: The Discarded Insignia
description: You meet a Fatui Electrohammer Vanguard on Minacious Isle who keeps going on about an insignia. It seems that you won't be able to get through to him... But if you find some way to bring him back to his senses, perhaps you might be able to figure out why he is here.

title: A Misplaced Conch
description: The Fatui team members you've brought back to their senses have all returned to the camp on the central island. You wonder if the Geochanter Bracer named Yakov has regained his wits or not...

title: Bake-Danuki Wanderlust
description: A bake-danuki seems to be looking for help on Pudding Isle...

title: Drama Phantasmagoria: Tale of the Sword-Wielding Princess!
description: The great Prinzessin's loyal subjects are pleased to perform for you, our guests, a performance most special: a tale of love and valor...

title: The Final Treasure
description: Miitoboru seems to have some request. Time to ask him about the details...

title: Treasure Clue: Broken Isle
description: Go near to the reef of Broken Isle to see if the pirates have left a clue to the treasure's location there.

title: Treasure Clue: Twinning Isle
description: Go near to the reef of Twinning Isle to see if the pirates have left a clue to the treasure's location there.

title: Treasure Clue: Minacious Isle
description: Go near to the reef of Minacious Isle to see if the pirates have left a clue to the treasure's location there.

title: Treasure Clue: Pudding Isle
description: Go near to the reef of Pudding Isle to see if the pirates have left a clue to the treasure's location there.

title: The Bake-Danukis' Gift
description: Mondstadt's Katheryne has a gift to pass on to you. It seems to have come from dancing bake-danuki...?

title: Returning Curios
description: Following Paimon's sage advice: "Chests of hidden Mora — gotta find 'em all!," you and Paimon decide to visit Idyia again, just to make sure you didn't miss any points of interest within Veluriyam Mirage. This turns out to be perfect timing, as Idyia has prepared something unique...

title: Daiya's Three-Day Reverie
description: In a corner of the Veluriyam Mirage, you and Paimon discover a strange announcement speaker, and following the instructions, it seems you can participate in a very unique attraction...

title: The Black Nacre and the All-Devouring Kraken
description: "An ancient legend resurfaces, and new clues to a priceless treasure are found. A band of chivalrous pirates hones their weapons and hoists the sails..."\nIntrigued, you and Paimon arrive at the set of The Black Nacre and the All-Devouring Kraken...

title: Petrifying Gaze
description: "To save their fallen friends, the now-alone Hydro Eidolon must break into the haunted fortress, and find a way to lift the curse..."\nIntrigued, you and Paimon arrive at the set of "Petrifying Gaze"...

title: Skycastle Saviors
description: "A town floating in the sky encounters an unprecedented crisis, and a miracle-working architect must act quickly to prevent the soaring city from crashing to the ground..."\nIntrigued, you and Paimon arrive at the set of Skycastle Saviors...

title: Capturing Light and Shadow
description: Following the tracks of a Choo-Choo Cart line, you and Paimon run into an enormous space in the cave with a mysterious mural in a very conspicuous spot, which seems to be illustrating someone's story in the "Veluriyam Mirage"...

title: A Starry Night, as Remembered
description: Jeroney wishes to be able to see the starry sky whenever he wants, so why not take a photo of it for him? Even if it's only the reflection inside the bottle and not the real thing, it will be beautiful enough.

title: Domain Adventures
description: Long ago, this mysterious domain appeared in Teyvat. To probe its arcane secrets, one must enter stone walls, ride carts, and raise the lamp in the tent. But, what is it all for?

title: Towards the Lighthouse, or Far Away
description: Something seems to be troubling someone in the collapsed lighthouse outside Brickstacks...

title: Narration Footnotes
description: Kirara says there are a few things she must investigate alone. As you're not a cat, curiosity won't kill you, so why not go with her...

title: The Lotus Leaf and the Champion
description: There seems to be a grand contest taking place at Rainsong Pond...

title: The Forest and the Princess
description: In the forest, a princess is preparing to go solve a certain problem herself...

title: The Answer of the Lotus Leaves and Forest
description: The champion paper frog Faurobert and Princess Cimest of the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells seem to be in a... slightly odd predicament.

title: "Owl Musician"
description: You encounter a serious guard in Constellation Metropole...

title: "Flying Hatter"
description: There is someone in Constellation Metropole who is most enamored with hats...

title: "Good Shelf"
description: In the Forest of Blessings dwells a paper frog who has made something interesting.

title: "Brave Northerly Wind"
description: In the Forest of Blessings lives a particularly passionate flying squirrel...

title: Text's Coda
description: After everything has come to an end, it's time to spare a thought for how to deal with the great clockwork key. It's not like you can just hold onto it...

title: Explore This World
description: You've somehow ended up in a strange land. Time to explore!

title: Involuntary Sacrifice
description: You hear from Ganyu and Lan that the Treasure Hoarders of Mondstadt and Liyue have banded together and plan to get involved in some ruins associated with the Abyss Order. Fearing the chaos that the Treasure Hoarders might cause through their involvement, you take up the commission and investigate...

title: A Herald Without Adherents
description: After fleeing from those creepy ruins, you meet Dainsleif by chance. You follow him and begin your pursuit of the Abyss Herald through those ruins once more...

title: Dishonorable Trial
description: To investigate the plan that the Abyss Order's talisman speaks of, you decide to head to the Cathedral in Mondstadt to consult the members of the Church.

title: A Soul Set Apart
description: You continue searching for "the first Field Tiller," following the information you've obtained from Barbara and the Great Wolf King of the North...

title: In the Depths, an Unexpected Reunion
description: Katheryne seems to have a new commission for you. Go check it out.

title: The Grave of the Guarded
description: You have an unexpected reunion with Dainsleif within The Chasm. After getting wind of the situation, you believe that this place must be intimately linked to the Abyss Order, and thus begin investigating...

title: Memories of Inteyvat
description: The Black Serpent Knights present here do not, in truth, mean you ill. They are simply driven by their remaining instincts to defend those hilichurls. After you discover some of the secrets of this strange city, the Black Serpent Knight Halfdan seems to have something to show you...

title: The Black Serpent Knights' Glory
description: Dainsleif figures out the Abyss Order's plan from the twin's memories left within the Inteyvat flower. Now to see if you can stop them or not...

title: Destined Encounter
description: Masrur at Port Ormos is currently worrying himself sick over a letter with an unclear address...

title: Fortune-Mocking Pedigree
description: As night passes and you awaken next to the bonfire, you realize that Paimon is missing. As you search for her, you come upon a wandering father by chance...

title: A Lamenter at Fate's End
description: The medicine meant to restore Caribert didn't work quite as expected. During the process of remaking the medicine, you seem to find yourself beset upon by strange phenomena...

title: Portended Fate
description: The previous events might have been mysterious, but miraculous. Caribert's consciousness has returned, and his mind is whole again. However, might this achievement bear a price yet unknown...

title: The Key That Unlocks Fate
description: Near the Collective of Plenty, you agree to help Iansan conduct a patrol. However, you stumble upon something completely unexpected...

title: "Savior"
description: Facing the Abyss Order's assault on Natlan, you decide to return to the cave where the key was lost, seeking a chance to end the conflict...

title: A Space and Time Without You
description: Many strange events have unfolded between you and the girl named Direidyth, all while the conflict between the Abyss Order and Natlan rages on. Amidst this turmoil, the one who will shift the tides of war is preparing to take the stage...

title: Cold Case Commission
description: You arrive at the Adventurers' Guild in Sumeru. Katheryne seems to have a very tricky commission for your docket...

title: Memories That Should Not Exist
description: You have heretofore been unable to track down the missing man, but you encounter a familiar figure after the creatures of the Abyss Order emerge...

title: World-Order Narration
description: As Dainsleif guessed, the "false memories" are a trap laid by the Abyss Order. The Ley Lines are disturbed again. Something is probably underway once more...

title: Quest Editor Test
description: This quest was made to test the Quest Editor, to see if the output data accepts the parameter and executes the release process normally.
